### PAG2::Kl（def、18 行）
noncomputable def Kl (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (r : ℕ) (c : ZMod N) : ℂ :=
  ∑ x : Fin r → ZMod N, if ∏ i, x i = c then ψ (∑ i, x i) else 0

### PAG2::addChar_sum（lemma、23 行）
omit [NeZero N] in
lemma addChar_sum {ι : Type*} (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (s : Finset ι) (x : ι → ZMod N) :
    ψ (∑ i ∈ s, x i) = ∏ i ∈ s, ψ (x i)

### PAG2::gaussSum_pow（lemma、31 行）
lemma gaussSum_pow (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (r : ℕ) :
    gaussSum χ ψ ^ r = ∑ x : Fin r → ZMod N, χ (∏ i, x i) * ψ (∑ i, x i)

### PAG2::charSum_gaussSum_pow（theorem、40 行）
theorem charSum_gaussSum_pow (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (r : ℕ) {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N, χ a⁻¹ * gaussSum χ ψ ^ r = N.totient * Kl ψ r a

### PAG2::inv_neg_unit（lemma、56 行）
omit [NeZero N] in
lemma inv_neg_unit {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) : (-a)⁻¹ = a⁻¹ * (-1)

### PAG2::charSum_parity（theorem、65 行）
theorem charSum_parity (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (r : ℕ) (we wo : ℂ)
    {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N,
        χ a⁻¹ * ((we * (1 + χ (-1)) + wo * (1 - χ (-1))) / 2) * gaussSum χ ψ ^ r
      = N.totient / 2 * ((we + wo) * Kl ψ r a + (we - wo) * Kl ψ r (-a))

### PAG2::conj_Kl（theorem、86 行）
theorem conj_Kl (r : ℕ) (c : ZMod N) :
    starRingEnd ℂ (Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r c) = Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r ((-1) ^ r * c)

### PAG2::Kl_neg_of_odd（theorem、105 行）
theorem Kl_neg_of_odd {r : ℕ} (hr : Odd r) (c : ZMod N) :
    Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r (-c) = starRingEnd ℂ (Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r c)

### PAG2::Kl_real_of_even（theorem、110 行）
theorem Kl_real_of_even {r : ℕ} (hr : Even r) (c : ZMod N) :
    (Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r c).im = 0

### PAG2::cas（def、121 行）
noncomputable def cas (z : ℂ) : ℂ := ((z.re + z.im : ℝ) : ℂ)

### PAG2::Wpow（def、124 行）
noncomputable def Wpow (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (r : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ((1 + χ (-1)) + (-I) ^ r * (1 - χ (-1))) / 2 * gaussSum χ ZMod.stdAddChar ^ r
    / (Real.sqrt N : ℂ) ^ r

### PAG2::parity_weight（lemma、131 行）
lemma parity_weight (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (r : ℕ) :
    ((1 + χ (-1)) + (-I) ^ r * (1 - χ (-1))) / 2 = if χ.Even then 1 else (-I) ^ r

### PAG2::S_eq（lemma、138 行）
lemma S_eq (r : ℕ) {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N, χ a⁻¹ * Wpow χ r
      = N.totient / 2 / (Real.sqrt N : ℂ) ^ r
          * ((1 + (-I) ^ r) * Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r a
              + (1 - (-I) ^ r) * Kl ZMod.stdAddChar r (-a))

### PAG2::S_odd（theorem、156 行）
theorem S_odd (k : ℕ) {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N, χ a⁻¹ * Wpow χ (2 * k + 1)
      = N.totient / (Real.sqrt N : ℂ) ^ (2 * k + 1)
          * cas (Kl ZMod.stdAddChar (2 * k + 1) ((-1) ^ k * a))

### PAG2::S_even（theorem、186 行）
theorem S_even (k : ℕ) {a : ZMod N} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N, χ a⁻¹ * Wpow χ (2 * k)
      = N.totient / (Real.sqrt N : ℂ) ^ (2 * k)
          * Kl ZMod.stdAddChar (2 * k) ((-1) ^ k * a)

### PAG2::cas_Kl_even（theorem、198 行）
theorem cas_Kl_even (k : ℕ) (c : ZMod N) :
    cas (Kl ZMod.stdAddChar (2 * k) c) = Kl ZMod.stdAddChar (2 * k) c

      = (if χ.Even then 1 else -I) * ∑ y : ZMod N, ZMod.stdAddChar (x * y) * χ y

### PAG4::T（def、17 行）
def T (a : ZMod N) : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun f x := f (x + a)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

### PAG4::M（def、23 行）
noncomputable def M (b : ZMod N) : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun f x := ZMod.stdAddChar (b * x) * f x
  map_add' f g := by funext x; simp [mul_add]
  map_smul' c f := by funext x; simp; ring

### PAG4::F（def、29 行）
noncomputable def F : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun f y := ∑ x, ZMod.stdAddChar (x * y) * f x
  map_add' f g := by funext y; simp [mul_add, sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c f := by funext y; simp [mul_sum]; refine sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring

### PAG4::F_comm_T（theorem、35 行）
theorem F_comm_T (a : ZMod N) : F ∘ₗ T a = M (-a) ∘ₗ F

### PAG4::F_comm_M（theorem、45 行）
theorem F_comm_M (b : ZMod N) : F ∘ₗ M b = T b ∘ₗ F

### PAG4::heisenberg_unique（theorem、55 行）
theorem heisenberg_unique (U : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ))
    (h1 : ∀ a, U ∘ₗ T a = M (-a) ∘ₗ U) (h2 : ∀ b, U ∘ₗ M b = T b ∘ₗ U) :
    ∃ c : ℂ, U = c • F

### PAG6::cv（def、17 行）
def cv (p K v : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  if v = K then 1
  else if K ≤ 2 * v then (Nat.totient (p ^ (K - v)) : ℤ)
  else if 2 * v + 1 = K then -((p : ℤ) ^ (K - v - 1))
  else 0

### PAG6::dj（def、24 行）
def dj (p K j : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  if j = 0 then 1
  else if 2 * j ≤ K then (Nat.totient (p ^ j) : ℤ)
  else if 2 * j = K + 1 then -((p : ℤ) ^ (j - 1))
  else 0

### PAG6::D（def、31 行）
def D (p K : ℕ) : ℤ := ∑ v ∈ range (K + 1), cv p K v

### PAG6::D_eq_sum_dj（theorem、34 行）
theorem D_eq_sum_dj (p K : ℕ) : D p K = ∑ j ∈ range (K + 1), dj p K j

### PAG6::sum_totient_int（theorem、54 行）
theorem sum_totient_int (p m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    (∑ i ∈ range m, (Nat.totient (p ^ (i + 1)) : ℤ)) = (p : ℤ) ^ m - 1

### PAG6::inner_sum（theorem、63 行）
theorem inner_sum (p K m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hm : 2 * m ≤ K) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (m + 1), dj p K j) = (p : ℤ) ^ m

### PAG6::D_even（theorem、75 行）
theorem D_even (p m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : D p (2 * m) = (p : ℤ) ^ m

### PAG6::D_odd（theorem、86 行）
theorem D_odd (p m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : D p (2 * m + 1) = 0

### PAG6::legFixed（def、102 行）
def legFixed (K : ℕ) : ℕ := ((range K).filter (fun v => v + v + 1 = K)).card

### PAG6::legFixed_eq（theorem、105 行）
theorem legFixed_eq (K : ℕ) : legFixed K = if K % 2 = 1 then 1 else 0

### PAG6::seesaw（theorem、118 行）
theorem seesaw (p K : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    (K % 2 = 0 → D p K = (p : ℤ) ^ (K / 2) ∧ legFixed K = 0) ∧
    (K % 2 = 1 → D p K = 0 ∧ legFixed K = 1)

### PAG6::trace_seesaw（theorem、133 行）
theorem trace_seesaw (p K : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    (D p K : ℝ) / (Real.sqrt p) ^ K + (legFixed K : ℝ) = 1

### PAG7::Meq（def、22 行）

### PAG7::Meq_cube（theorem、25 行）

### PAG7::EqData（structure、36 行）
structure EqData (H0 Hi : V →ₗ[R] V) (e0 : V) (κ : R) : Prop where
  h0sq : H0 (H0 e0) = e0
  hisq : Hi (Hi e0) = e0
  h0_on_um : H0 (Hi e0) = κ • H0 e0
  hi_on_up : Hi (H0 e0) = κ • Hi e0

### PAG7::cube_e0（theorem、45 行）
theorem cube_e0 (h : EqData H0 Hi e0 κ) :
    (H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) e0)) = (2 + κ ^ 2) • (H0 + Hi) e0 + (2 * κ) • e0

### PAG7::cube_eq_two_of_kappa_zero（theorem、51 行）
theorem cube_eq_two_of_kappa_zero (h : EqData H0 Hi e0 0) :
    (H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) e0)) = (2 : R) • (H0 + Hi) e0 ∧
    (H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) (H0 e0))) = (2 : R) • (H0 + Hi) (H0 e0) ∧
    (H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) ((H0 + Hi) (Hi e0))) = (2 : R) • (H0 + Hi) (Hi e0)

### PAG7::block_action（theorem、60 行）
theorem block_action (h : EqData H0 Hi e0 0) :
    (H0 + Hi) e0 = H0 e0 + Hi e0 ∧ (H0 + Hi) (H0 e0) = e0 ∧ (H0 + Hi) (Hi e0) = e0

### PAG7::J（def、75 行）
noncomputable def J (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) : ℂ := ∑ x, χ₁ x * χ₂ (1 - x)

### PAG7::fiber（def、81 行）
noncomputable def fiber (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (s : ZMod N) : ℂ := ∑ x, χ₁ x * χ₂ (s - x)

### PAG7::gauss_mul_gauss_eq_sum_fiber（theorem、84 行）
theorem gauss_mul_gauss_eq_sum_fiber (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ) :
    gaussSum χ₁ ψ * gaussSum χ₂ ψ = ∑ s, ψ s * fiber χ₁ χ₂ s

### PAG7::fiber_one（theorem、98 行）
theorem fiber_one (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) : fiber χ₁ χ₂ 1 = J χ₁ χ₂

### PAG7::fiber_unit（theorem、101 行）
theorem fiber_unit (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (s : (ZMod N)ˣ) :
    fiber χ₁ χ₂ s = (χ₁ * χ₂) s * J χ₁ χ₂

### PAG7::gauss_mul_gauss_eq_jacobi_mul（theorem、113 行）
theorem gauss_mul_gauss_eq_jacobi_mul (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar (ZMod N) ℂ) (ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ)
    (hnon : ∀ s : ZMod N, ¬ IsUnit s → fiber χ₁ χ₂ s = 0) :
    gaussSum χ₁ ψ * gaussSum χ₂ ψ = J χ₁ χ₂ * gaussSum (χ₁ * χ₂) ψ

### PAG7::gauss_sq_prime（theorem、124 行）
theorem gauss_sq_prime {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hχ : χ * χ ≠ 1)
    (ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ) :
    gaussSum χ ψ ^ 2 = J χ χ * gaussSum (χ * χ) ψ

### PAG7::W_sq（theorem、134 行）
theorem W_sq (τ τ₂ Jv : ℂ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (a : ℕ) (h : τ ^ 2 = Jv * τ₂) :
    (τ / (I ^ a * (Real.sqrt q : ℂ))) ^ 2 = (-1) ^ a * (Jv / (Real.sqrt q : ℂ)) * (τ₂ / (Real.sqrt q : ℂ))

### PAG7::push（def、153 行）
noncomputable def push (p : ZMod N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (w : ZMod N) : ℂ :=

### PAG7::pull（def、157 行）

### PAG10::ind（def、17 行）
def ind {X W : Type*} [DecidableEq W] (shell : X → W) (a : W → R) (w : W) : X → R :=
  fun x => if shell x = w then a w else 0

### PAG10::ind_mul_ind（theorem、21 行）
theorem ind_mul_ind {X W : Type*} [DecidableEq W] (shell : X → W) (a : W → R) (w₀ w₁ : W) :
    ind shell a w₀ * ind shell a w₁ = if w₀ = w₁ then a w₀ • ind shell a w₀ else 0

### PAG10::Bcv（def、35 行）
def Bcv (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (f g : A) : A := α • F.symm (F f * F g)

### PAG10::Bcv_comm（theorem、37 行）
theorem Bcv_comm (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (f g : A) : Bcv F α f g = Bcv F α g f

### PAG10::Bcv_assoc（theorem、40 行）
theorem Bcv_assoc (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (f g h : A) :
    Bcv F α (Bcv F α f g) h = Bcv F α f (Bcv F α g h)

### PAG10::Bcv_dual（theorem、46 行）
theorem Bcv_dual {W : Type*} [DecidableEq W] (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (e : W → A) (c : W → R)
    (he : ∀ w₀ w₁, e w₀ * e w₁ = if w₀ = w₁ then c w₀ • e w₀ else 0) (w₀ w₁ : W) :
    Bcv F α (F.symm (e w₀)) (F.symm (e w₁)) =
      if w₀ = w₁ then (α * c w₀) • F.symm (e w₀) else 0

### PAG10::cvpow（def、57 行）
def cvpow (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (f : A) : ℕ → A
  | 0 => f
  | n + 1 => Bcv F α f (cvpow F α f n)

### PAG10::cvpow_dual（theorem、62 行）
theorem cvpow_dual (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (e : A) (c : R) (he : e * e = c • e) (n : ℕ) :
    cvpow F α (F.symm e) n = (α * c) ^ n • F.symm e

### PAG10::Bcv_idempotent（theorem、73 行）
theorem Bcv_idempotent {K : Type*} [Field K] {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra K B]
    (F : B ≃ₗ[K] B) (α : K) (e : B) (c : K) (he : e * e = c • e) :
    Bcv F α ((α * c)⁻¹ • F.symm e) ((α * c)⁻¹ • F.symm e) = (α * c)⁻¹ • F.symm e

### PAG10::Bcv_dual_ind（theorem、82 行）
theorem Bcv_dual_ind {X W : Type*} [DecidableEq W] (shell : X → W) (a : W → R)
    (F : (X → R) ≃ₗ[R] (X → R)) (α : R) (w₀ w₁ : W) :
    Bcv F α (F.symm (ind shell a w₀)) (F.symm (ind shell a w₁)) =
      if w₀ = w₁ then (α * a w₀) • F.symm (ind shell a w₀) else 0

theorem cascade_wild (hodd : Odd p) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {r m : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime m p) (hr : r < n)
    {K v : ℤ} (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hvK : v + (n + 1) ≤ K) :
    (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).conductor = p ^ (n + 1 - r) ∧
      D K ((n + 1 - r : ℕ) : ℤ) (D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v) = v + r ∧
      (r : ℤ) ≤ D K ((n + 1 - r : ℕ) : ℤ) (D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v) ∧
      D K ((n + 1 - r : ℕ) : ℤ) (D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v) ≤ K - ((n + 1 - r : ℕ) : ℤ)

### PAG14::cascade_tame（theorem、85 行）
theorem cascade_tame (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {r m : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime m p) (hr : n ≤ r) (hd : ¬ tameOrder χ ∣ m)
    {K v : ℤ} (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hvK : v + (n + 1) ≤ K) :
    (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).conductor = p ∧
      D K 1 (D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v) = v + n ∧
      (n : ℤ) ≤ D K 1 (D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v) ∧ D K 1 (D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v) ≤ K - 1

### PAG14::cascade_radial（theorem、96 行）
theorem cascade_radial (hodd : Odd p) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {r m : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime m p) (hr : n ≤ r) (hd : tameOrder χ ∣ m)
    {K v : ℤ} (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hvK : v + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    {R A : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (F : A ≃ₗ[R] A) (α : R) (e : A) (c : R)
    (he : e * e = c • e) :
    χ ^ (p ^ r * m) = 1 ∧ (χ ^ (p ^ r * m)).conductor = 1 ∧
      0 ≤ D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v ∧ D K ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) v ≤ K - ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, PAG.Part10.cvpow F α (F.symm e) k = (α * c) ^ k • F.symm e

### PAG14::epsBall（def、117 行）
def epsBall (P : ℕ → R) (K w : ℕ) : R := if w < K then P w - P (w + 1) else P K

### PAG14::sum_epsBall（theorem、120 行）
theorem sum_epsBall (P : ℕ → R) (K : ℕ) : ∑ w ∈ range (K + 1), epsBall P K w = P 0

### PAG14::epsBall_mul（theorem、128 行）
theorem epsBall_mul (P : ℕ → R) (K : ℕ) (habs : ∀ a b, a ≤ b → b ≤ K → P a * P b = P b)
    {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ K) (hb : b ≤ K) :
    epsBall P K a * epsBall P K b = if a = b then epsBall P K a else 0

### PAG14::sum_epsBall_eq_one（theorem、168 行）
theorem sum_epsBall_eq_one (P : ℕ → R) (K : ℕ) (h0 : P 0 = 1) :
    ∑ w ∈ range (K + 1), epsBall P K w = 1

### PAG14::stationary_phase（theorem、181 行）
theorem stationary_phase (A y : ZMod M) :
    ∑ t : ZMod M, ZMod.stdAddChar (-A * t) * ZMod.stdAddChar (y * t)
      = if y = A then (M : ℂ) else 0

### PAG14::lift_invariance（theorem、192 行）

### PAG15::conv（def、20 行）
def conv (f g : G → K) : G → K := fun x => ∑ y, f y * g (x - y)

### PAG15::conv_comm（theorem、22 行）

### PAG15::convL（def、29 行）
def convL : (G → K) →ₗ[K] (G → K) →ₗ[K] (G → K) :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ K conv
    (fun f₁ f₂ g => by funext x; simp [conv, add_mul, sum_add_distrib])
    (fun c f g => by funext x; simp [conv, mul_sum, mul_assoc])
    (fun f g₁ g₂ => by funext x; simp [conv, mul_add, sum_add_distrib])
    (fun c f g => by funext x; simp [conv, mul_sum, mul_left_comm])

### PAG17::AS（def、43 行）
def AS {X : Type*} (Nn : Set X) : Submodule K (X → K) where
  carrier := {f | ∀ x ∈ Nn, f x = 0}
  add_mem' ha hb x hx := by simp [ha x hx, hb x hx]
  zero_mem' x _ := rfl
  smul_mem' c f hf x hx := by simp [hf x hx]

    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) :
    Complex.normSq (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar / gaussSum ψ stdAddChar)
      = ((p ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((p ^ (n + 1 - v) : ℕ) : ℝ)

### PAG18::conv_shell_general（theorem、104 行）
theorem conv_shell_general {G L H : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [AddCommGroup L] [Fintype L]
    [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H]
    (ι : L →+ G) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (π : L →+ H) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (f g : H → ℂ) :

### PAG18::conv_shell_descent（theorem、112 行）
theorem conv_shell_descent {G L : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [AddCommGroup L] [Fintype L]
    (ι : L →+ G) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n)
    (π : L →+ ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)

### PAG19::ram（def、20 行）
noncomputable def ram (x : ZMod N) : ℂ :=
  ∑ k : ZMod N, stdAddChar (k * x) * (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (-k)

### PAG19::conv_shell_inv（theorem、30 行）

    (ι : L →+ G) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (π : L →+ ZMod N) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (push ι ((χ : ZMod N → ℂ) ∘ π)) (push ι (((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : ZMod N → ℂ) ∘ π))
      = (((univ.filter (fun z : L => π z = 0)).card : ℂ) * χ (-1)) • push ι (ram (N := N) ∘ π)

### PAG19::sz（def、76 行）
def sz (p K u : ℕ) : ℕ := p ^ (K - 1 - u) * (p - 1)

### PAG19::coef_identity（theorem、82 行）
theorem coef_identity (p K c w v c'' a : ℕ) (hc : c = v + c'' + 1) (hK : K = w + c + a) :
    sz p K (w + v) * (p ^ (K - w - c)) ^ 2 * p ^ (c + v) * sz p K (K - c - w) = p ^ K * (sz p K w) ^ 2

### PAG19::coef_identity_real（theorem、93 行）
theorem coef_identity_real (p K c w v c'' a : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hc : c = v + c'' + 1) (hK : K = w + c + a) :
    (sz p K (w + v) : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) ^ (K - w - c)) ^ 2 * (p : ℝ) ^ (c + v) / (sz p K w : ℝ) ^ 2
      = (p : ℝ) ^ K / sz p K (K - c - w)

### PAG21::push_comp（theorem、30 行）
theorem push_comp (K w c v : ℕ) (hw : w + c ≤ K) (hv : v ≤ c) (f : ZMod (p ^ (c - v)) → ℂ) :
    push (shellEmb (p := p) K w (by omega))
        (push (shellEmb (p := p) c v hv) f ∘
          (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c ≤ K - w)) (ZMod (p ^ c))).toAddMonoidHom)
      = push (shellEmb (p := p) K (w + v) (by omega))
          (f ∘ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c - v ≤ K - (w + v))) (ZMod (p ^ (c - v)))).toAddMonoidHom)

### PAG21::ket（def、93 行）
noncomputable def ket (K u c : ℕ) (huc : u + c ≤ K) (χ : ZMod (p ^ c) → ℂ) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ :=
  have : NeZero (p ^ (K - u)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hp.out.ne_zero⟩
  (((Real.sqrt (sz p K u))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    push (shellEmb (p := p) K u (by omega))
      (χ ∘ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : c ≤ K - u)) (ZMod (p ^ c))).toAddMonoidHom)

### PAG21::thmA_ket（theorem、101 行）
theorem thmA_ket (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)
      = ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)) : ℝ) *
          (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar /
            (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) : ℂ) •
        ket K (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) ψ

### PAG22::ball（def、17 行）
noncomputable def ball (K j : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ := fun x => if p ^ j ∣ x.val then 1 else 0

### PAG22::val_shellEmb（theorem、20 行）
theorem val_shellEmb (K w : ℕ) (hw : w ≤ K) (y : ZMod (p ^ (K - w))) :
    (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw y).val = (p ^ w * y.val) % p ^ K

### PAG22::dvd_val_shellEmb（theorem、25 行）

    p ^ (w + j) ∣ (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw y).val ↔ p ^ j ∣ y.val

### PAG22::mem_range_iff（theorem、31 行）
theorem mem_range_iff (K w : ℕ) (hw : w ≤ K) (x : ZMod (p ^ K)) :
    (∃ y, shellEmb (p := p) K w hw y = x) ↔ p ^ w ∣ x.val

### PAG22::push_ball（theorem、45 行）
theorem push_ball (K w j : ℕ) (hw : w ≤ K) (hj : w + j ≤ K) (a : ℂ) :
    push (shellEmb (p := p) K w hw) (fun y : ZMod (p ^ (K - w)) => if p ^ j ∣ y.val then a else 0)
      = a • ball (p := p) K (w + j)

### PAG22::ram_pull（theorem、60 行）
theorem ram_pull (M n : ℕ) (hM : n + 1 ≤ M) (y : ZMod (p ^ M)) :
    ram (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p hM) (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) y)
      = (if p ^ (n + 1) ∣ y.val then ((p ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0)
        - (if p ^ (n + 1 - 1) ∣ y.val then ((p ^ (n + 1 - 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0)

### PAG22::push_sub（theorem、75 行）

    (hι : Function.Injective ι) (f g : H → ℂ) : push ι (f - g) = push ι f - push ι g

### PAG22::thmB_balls（theorem、85 行）
theorem thmB_balls (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      = (((p : ℂ) ^ (K - w - (n + 1)) / (sz p K w : ℂ)) * χ (-1)) •
          (((p ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) • ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1))
            - ((p ^ (n + 1 - 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) • ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1 - 1)))

### PAG22::thmB_closed（theorem、107 行）
theorem thmB_closed (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      = χ (-1) • (ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1))
          - ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹ • (ball (p := p) K (w + n) - ball (p := p) K (w + (n + 1))))

    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (h₁₂ : (χ₁ * χ₂).IsPrimitive) :
    BS (kS K 0 (n + 1) h χ₁) (kS K 0 (n + 1) h χ₂)
      = ((((Real.sqrt (sz p K 0))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((p ^ (K - (n + 1)) : ℕ) : ℂ) * PAG.Part7.J χ₁ χ₂)) •
          kS K 0 (n + 1) h (χ₁ * χ₂)

### PAG25::equator_residue（theorem、159 行）
theorem equator_residue (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 + (0 + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (0 + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    BS (kS K 0 (0 + 1) hK χ) (kS K 0 (0 + 1) hK χ⁻¹) - χ (-1) • extS (ball (p := p) K 1)
      = -(χ (-1) * ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹) • Eq1 (p ^ K) ∧
    BN (kN K 0 (0 + 1) hK χ) (kN K 0 (0 + 1) hK χ⁻¹) - χ (-1) • extN (ball (p := p) K 1)
      = -(χ (-1) * ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹) • Eq1 (p ^ K)

### PAG26::Pt（abbrev、20 行）
abbrev Pt (N : ℕ) := ZMod N ⊕ {y : ZMod N // ¬ IsUnit y}

### PAG26::toP1（def、23 行）
noncomputable def toP1 (f : Pt N → ℂ) : P1F N :=
  (fun x => f (Sum.inl x), fun y => if h : IsUnit y then f (Sum.inl y⁻¹) else f (Sum.inr ⟨y, h⟩))

### PAG26::ofP1（def、27 行）
def ofP1 (F : P1F N) : Pt N → ℂ
  | Sum.inl x => F.1 x
  | Sum.inr y => F.2 y.1

### PAG26::compat_toP1（theorem、31 行）
theorem compat_toP1 (f : Pt N → ℂ) : Compat (toP1 f)

### PAG26::ofP1_toP1（theorem、34 行）
theorem ofP1_toP1 (f : Pt N → ℂ) : ofP1 (toP1 f) = f

### PAG26::toP1_ofP1（theorem、40 行）
theorem toP1_ofP1 {F : P1F N} (hF : Compat F) : toP1 (ofP1 F) = F

### PAG26::compatSub（def、49 行）
def compatSub (N : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ (P1F N) where
  carrier := {F | Compat F}
  add_mem' := fun {F G} hF hG y hy => by
    simp only [Prod.snd_add, Prod.fst_add, Pi.add_apply, hF y hy, hG y hy]
  zero_mem' := fun y _ => rfl
  smul_mem' := fun a {F} hF y hy => by
    simp only [Prod.smul_snd, Prod.smul_fst, Pi.smul_apply, hF y hy]

### PAG26::ptEquiv（def、58 行）
noncomputable def ptEquiv (N : ℕ) : (Pt N → ℂ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] compatSub N where
  toFun f := ⟨toP1 f, compat_toP1 f⟩
  invFun F := ofP1 F.1
  map_add' f g := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext y
    · rfl
    · simp only [toP1, Pi.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add, Prod.snd_add]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
  map_smul' a f := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext y
    · rfl
    · simp only [toP1, Pi.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, Prod.smul_snd, RingHom.id_apply]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
  left_inv f := ofP1_toP1 f
  right_inv F := Subtype.ext (toP1_ofP1 F.2)

### PAG26::Wpt（def、77 行）
noncomputable def Wpt : Pt N → Pt N
  | Sum.inl x => if h : IsUnit x then Sum.inl x⁻¹ else Sum.inr ⟨x, h⟩
  | Sum.inr y => Sum.inl y.1

### PAG26::Wpt_Wpt（theorem、81 行）
theorem Wpt_Wpt (z : Pt N) : Wpt (Wpt z) = z

### PAG26::WptEquiv（def、90 行）
noncomputable def WptEquiv (N : ℕ) : Equiv.Perm (Pt N) :=
  Function.Involutive.toPerm Wpt Wpt_Wpt

### PAG26::toP1_comp_Wpt（theorem、94 行）
theorem toP1_comp_Wpt (f : Pt N → ℂ) : toP1 (f ∘ Wpt) = W (toP1 f)

### PAG26::ofP1_W（theorem、105 行）
theorem ofP1_W {F : P1F N} (hF : Compat F) : ofP1 (W F) = ofP1 F ∘ Wpt

### PAG26::isUnitEquiv（def、111 行）
noncomputable def isUnitEquiv (N : ℕ) : {x : ZMod N // IsUnit x} ≃ (ZMod N)ˣ where
  toFun x := x.2.unit
  invFun u := ⟨u, u.isUnit⟩
  left_inv x := by simp
  right_inv u := by ext; simp

### PAG26::card_Pt（theorem、120 行）
theorem card_Pt (K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) : Fintype.card (Pt (p ^ K)) = p ^ K + p ^ (K - 1)

### PAG27::Unimod（def、20 行）
def Unimod (N : ℕ) := {v : ZMod N × ZMod N // ∃ s t : ZMod N, s * v.1 + t * v.2 = 1}

### PAG27::projSetoid（def、23 行）
def projSetoid (N : ℕ) : Setoid (Unimod N) where
  r v w := ∃ u : (ZMod N)ˣ, w.1.1 = u * v.1.1 ∧ w.1.2 = u * v.1.2
  iseqv := {
    refl := fun v => ⟨1, by simp, by simp⟩
    symm := fun {v w} ⟨u, h1, h2⟩ => ⟨u⁻¹, by rw [h1, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul],
      by rw [h2, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]⟩
    trans := fun {v w z} ⟨u, h1, h2⟩ ⟨u', h1', h2'⟩ => ⟨u' * u, by rw [h1', h1, Units.val_mul, mul_assoc],
      by rw [h2', h2, Units.val_mul, mul_assoc]⟩ }

### PAG27::ProjLine（def、33 行）
def ProjLine (N : ℕ) := Quotient (projSetoid N)

### PAG28::shellInd（def、106 行）

### PAG28::eu（def、127 行）

### PAG28::cascade_eu（theorem、141 行）
theorem cascade_eu (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) :
    cascade (p := p) K w n
      = (-(((Real.sqrt (sz p K (w + n)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹)) • eu (p := p) K (w + n)
        + ∑ u ∈ Ico (w + (n + 1)) K, ((Real.sqrt (sz p K u) : ℝ) : ℂ) • eu (p := p) K u
        + eu (p := p) K K

### PAG28::thmB_eu（theorem、159 行）
theorem thmB_eu (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ) (ket K w (n + 1) hK ((χ⁻¹ : DirichletCharacter ℂ _) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
      = χ (-1) • ((-(((Real.sqrt (sz p K (w + n)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((p : ℂ) - 1)⁻¹)) • eu (p := p) K (w + n)

### PAG28::thmA_south（theorem、228 行）
theorem thmA_south (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : ∀ x, (χ₁ * χ₂) x = ψ (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)) _ x)) :
    BS (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)
      = ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ)) : ℝ) *
          (gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar /
            (gaussSum ψ stdAddChar * ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) : ℂ) •
        kS K (w + v) (n + 1 - v) (by omega) ψ

### PAG28::descent_equator_zero（theorem、243 行）
theorem descent_equator_zero (K w n v : ℕ) (hv1 : 1 ≤ v) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)

    {x : ZMod (p ^ K)} (hx : IsUnit x) :
    (BS (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)).1 x = 0 ∧
    (BS (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (kS K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)).2 x = 0 ∧
    (BN (kN K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (kN K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)).1 x = 0 ∧
    (BN (kN K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (kN K w (n + 1) hK χ₂)).2 x = 0

### PAG32::negProj（def、22 行）
def negProj : ProjLine N → ProjLine N :=
  Quotient.lift (fun v : Unimod N => mk ⟨(-v.1.1, v.1.2), by
      obtain ⟨s, t, h⟩ := v.2; exact ⟨-s, t, by rw [neg_mul_neg]; exact h⟩⟩)
    (fun _v _w ⟨u, h1, h2⟩ => mk_eq_mk u (by simp [h1]) h2)

### PAG33::factorsEquiv（def、25 行）
noncomputable def factorsEquiv {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (hd : d ∣ N) :
    DirichletCharacter ℂ d ≃ {ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N // ψ.FactorsThrough d} :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (fun χ₀ => ⟨DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hd χ₀, ⟨hd, χ₀, rfl⟩⟩)
    ⟨fun a b h => DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_injective hd (congrArg Subtype.val h),
     fun ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ => by
       obtain ⟨h', χ₀, e⟩ := hψ
       exact ⟨χ₀, Subtype.ext e.symm⟩⟩

    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hψ : ψ.FactorsThrough (p ^ m)) : (χ₁⁻¹ * ψ).IsPrimitive

### PAG33::shiftEquiv（def、76 行）
noncomputable def shiftEquiv (hc : 1 ≤ c) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ c) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)))
    (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) :
    {χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) // χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧ (χ₁ * χ₂).FactorsThrough (p ^ m)}
      ≃ {ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1)) // ψ.FactorsThrough (p ^ m)} where
  toFun χ₂ := ⟨χ₁ * χ₂.1, χ₂.2.2⟩
  invFun ψ := ⟨χ₁⁻¹ * ψ.1, inv_mul_prim hc hm χ₁ ψ.1 h₁ ψ.2, by rw [mul_inv_cancel_left]; exact ψ.2⟩
  left_inv χ₂ := Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel_left χ₁ χ₂.1)
  right_inv ψ := Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel_left χ₁ ψ.1)

### PAG34::sym_ketS（theorem、150 行）
theorem sym_ketS (w c : ℕ) (h : w + c ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c)) :
    sym false false (ketS_proj K hK w c h χ) = ketS_proj K hK w c h χ ∧
    sym false true (ketS_proj K hK w c h χ) = χ (-1) • ketS_proj K hK w c h χ⁻¹ ∧
    sym true false (ketS_proj K hK w c h χ) = ketN_proj K hK w c h χ⁻¹ ∧
    sym true true (ketS_proj K hK w c h χ) = χ (-1) • ketN_proj K hK w c h χ

### PAG44::unitHom（def、103 行）
noncomputable def unitHom (d s j : ℕ) : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ →* ℂˣ where
  toFun u := Units.mk0 (val d s j u) (val_ne_zero s j u)
  map_one' := by
    ext
    have := val_formula (d := d) s j 0 0
    simp only [pow_zero, mul_one, mul_zero] at this
    simp [this]
  map_mul' u u' := by
    ext
    simp only [Units.val_mk0, Units.val_mul]
    rw [rep_spec u, rep_spec u']
    rw [show (-1 : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ) ^ ((rep d u).1 : ℕ) * five (d + 3) ^ ((rep d u).2 : ℕ) *
        ((-1) ^ ((rep d u').1 : ℕ) * five (d + 3) ^ ((rep d u').2 : ℕ))
        = (-1) ^ (((rep d u).1 : ℕ) + ((rep d u').1 : ℕ)) * five (d + 3) ^ (((rep d u).2 : ℕ) + ((rep d u').2 : ℕ)) by
      rw [pow_add (-1 : (ZMod (2 ^ (d + 3)))ˣ), pow_add (five (d + 3))]; exact mul_mul_mul_comm _ _ _ _]
    rw [val_formula, val_formula, val_formula, mul_add, mul_add, pow_add (-1 : ℂ), pow_add (zeta d)]
    ring

### PAG48::conv_ket_classification（theorem、34 行）
theorem conv_ket_classification (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    (K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ ≠ K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂ ∧ conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = 0) ∨
    (K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁ = K - (n₂ + 1) - w₂ ∧
      ∃ w c, ∃ h : w + c ≤ K, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
        Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n₁ + 1) - w₁) : ℝ) ∧
        conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = C • ket K w c h ψ) ∨
    (w₁ = w₂ ∧ n₁ = n₂ ∧
      conv (ket K w₁ (n₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket K w₂ (n₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) = χ₁ (-1) • ballB (p := p) K w₁ n₁)

### PAG50::p2_caseA（theorem、52 行）

    {m : ℕ} (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ d + 3)

theorem ket_orthonormal (K w₁ n₁ w₂ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (n₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (n₂ + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :

      = if (hn ▸ χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n₂ + 1))) = χ₂ then 1 else 0)

### PAG53::p2_classification（theorem、17 行）
theorem p2_classification (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (d + 3) ≤ K) (s j s' j' : ℕ) (hj : Odd j) (hj' : Odd j') :
    (Even (s + s') ∧ 2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j' ∧
      conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s' j'))
        = ((-1 : ℂ) ^ s) • ballB (p := 2) K w (d + 2)) ∨
    (¬ 2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j' ∧ 1 ≤ padicValNat 2 (j + j') ∧ padicValNat 2 (j + j') ≤ d ∧
      ∃ u c, ∃ h : u + c ≤ K, u = w + padicValNat 2 (j + j') ∧ c = d + 3 - padicValNat 2 (j + j') ∧
        ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ c), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
          Complex.normSq C = (2 : ℝ) ^ K / (sz 2 K (K - (d + 3) - w) : ℝ) ∧
          conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s' j'))
            = C • ket (p := 2) K u c h ψ) ∨
    (2 ^ (d + 1) ∣ j + j' ∧ Odd (s + s') ∧
      ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2 ^ 2), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
        Complex.normSq C = (2 : ℝ) ^ K / (sz 2 K (K - (d + 3) - w) : ℝ) ∧
        conv (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s j)) (ket (p := 2) K w (d + 3) hK (chiSJ d s' j'))
          = C • ket (p := 2) K (w + (d + 1)) 2 (by omega) ψ)

### PAG54::family（def、22 行）
def family (K : ℕ) : Set (ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) :=
  {f | (∃ w c, ∃ h : w + c ≤ K, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ c), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ f = ket K w c h ψ) ∨
    (∃ w, ∃ hw : w < K, f = shellInd K w hw) ∨ f = Pi.single 0 1}

### PAG63::odd_classification（theorem、30 行）
theorem odd_classification (hc : 1 ≤ c) (K w : ℕ) (hK : w + (c + 1) ≤ K) (j j' : ℕ)
    (hj : ¬ p ∣ j) (hj' : ¬ p ∣ j') :
    (phi (p := p) c ∣ j + j' ∧
      conv (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
        = (omega c hp2 ^ j) (-1) • ballB (p := p) K w c) ∨
    (padicValNat p (j + j') ≤ c - 1 ∧
      ∃ u m, ∃ h : u + m ≤ K, u = w + padicValNat p (j + j') ∧ m = c + 1 - padicValNat p (j + j') ∧
        ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ m), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
          Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (c + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
          conv (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
            (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
            = C • ket K u m h ψ) ∨
    (c ≤ padicValNat p (j + j') ∧ ¬ phi (p := p) c ∣ j + j' ∧
      ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ 1), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧ ∃ C : ℂ,
        Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (c + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
        conv (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
          (ket K w (c + 1) hK ((omega c hp2 ^ j' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c + 1))) : ZMod _ → ℂ))
          = C • ket K (w + c) 1 (by omega) ψ)

### PAG64::unified_classification（theorem、18 行）
theorem unified_classification (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : (χ₁ * χ₂).conductor = p ^ i) :
    (i = 0 ∧ conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂) = χ₁ (-1) • ballB (p := p) K w n) ∨
    (1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ n + 1 ∧ ∃ h : w + (n + 1 - i) + i ≤ K, ∃ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ i), ψ.IsPrimitive ∧
      ∃ C : ℂ, Complex.normSq C = (p : ℝ) ^ K / (sz p K (K - (n + 1) - w) : ℝ) ∧
        conv (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₁) (ket K w (n + 1) hK χ₂) = C • ket K (w + (n + 1 - i)) i h ψ)

### PAG90::prodConv（def、16 行）
noncomputable def prodConv {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (k : ZMod N → ℂ) : List (ZMod N → ℂ) → ZMod N → ℂ
  | [] => k
  | k' :: l => conv k (prodConv k' l)

### PAG90::KetDual（def、21 行）
def KetDual (K a : ℕ) (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ w n : ℕ, ∃ h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K, ∃ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)), χ.IsPrimitive ∧
    K - (n + 1) - w = a ∧ f = ket K w (n + 1) h χ

    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (χ'' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n'' + 1)))

### PAG110::pullEquiv（def、168 行）
noncomputable def pullEquiv (K a : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (ha : a ≤ K) :
    Va (p := p) K a ≃ₗ[ℂ] Va (p := p) (K + 1) (a + 1) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective
    (LinearMap.codRestrict (Va (p := p) (K + 1) (a + 1)) ((pullL (p := p) K).domRestrict (Va (p := p) K a))
      (fun f => (Va_eq_span (K + 1) (a + 1) (by omega) (pull K (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ))).mp
        (PAG.Part105.pull_Va K a ha (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ) ((Va_eq_span K a ha (f : ZMod (p ^ K) → ℂ)).mpr f.2))))
    ⟨fun x y hxy => Subtype.ext (pull_injective K (congrArg Subtype.val hxy)), fun g => by
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfg⟩ := (Va_succ_eq_pull K a hK ha (g : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) → ℂ)).mp
        ((Va_eq_span (K + 1) (a + 1) (by omega) (g : ZMod (p ^ (K + 1)) → ℂ)).mpr g.2)
      exact ⟨⟨f, (Va_eq_span K a ha f).mp hf⟩, Subtype.ext hfg⟩⟩

### PAG116::prod_closed（theorem、16 行）
theorem prod_closed {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (T : Finset α) (F : α → ℂ) (t₀ : α) (o : ℕ) (ho : 0 < o)
    (hF0 : F t₀ ≠ 0) (hpow : ∀ t ∈ T, (F t / F t₀) ^ o = 1)
    (hfib : ∀ ξ : ℂ, ξ ^ o = 1 → o * (T.filter (fun t => F t = F t₀ * ξ)).card = T.card) :
    ∏ t ∈ T, (X - C (F t)) = (X ^ o - C (F t₀ ^ o)) ^ (T.card / o)

### PAG116::ket_root_facts（theorem、67 行）
theorem ket_root_facts (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀ ≠ 0 ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w),
      (𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t / 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀) ^ orderOf χ = 1) ∧
    (∀ ξ : ℂ, ξ ^ orderOf χ = 1 → orderOf χ * ((Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)).filter
        (fun t => 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t = 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t₀ * ξ)).card
        = (Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)).card)

### PAG121::basis12（def、111 行）
noncomputable def basis12 (K L a b : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ K) (hb : b ≤ L)
    (hcard : Fintype.card (Idx (p := p) (q := q) K L a b) = Module.finrank ℂ (V12 (p := p) (q := q) K L a b)) :
    Module.Basis (Idx (p := p) (q := q) K L a b) ℂ (V12 (p := p) (q := q) K L a b) :=
  basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank'
    (fun i => ⟨Psi ((i.1 : ZMod (p ^ K)), (i.2 : ZMod (q ^ L))), Psi_mem K L a b ha hb i⟩)
    (by
      apply LinearIndependent.of_comp (V12 (p := p) (q := q) K L a b).subtype
      exact Psi_linearIndependent (fun i : Idx (p := p) (q := q) K L a b => ((i.1 : ZMod (p ^ K)), (i.2 : ZMod (q ^ L))))
        (fun i j h => by
          obtain ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, ⟨t, ht⟩⟩ := i; obtain ⟨⟨s', hs'⟩, ⟨t', ht'⟩⟩ := j
          simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h; obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h; rfl))
    hcard

### PAG121::T12（def、136 行）

    Module.End ℂ (V12 (p := p) (q := q) K L a b) :=

### PAG121::charpoly_T12（theorem、143 行）
theorem charpoly_T12 (K L w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (c₂ + 1) ≤ L)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (c₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    (T12 (p := p) (q := q) K L (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂) (by omega) (by omega)
        (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂)).charpoly
      = ∏ s ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁), ∏ t ∈ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂),
          (X - C (𝓕 (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) s * 𝓕 (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) t))

### PAG122::Unif（def、19 行）
def Unif (T : Finset α) (F : α → ℂ) (t₀ : α) (o : ℕ) : Prop :=
  t₀ ∈ T ∧ 0 < o ∧ F t₀ ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ t ∈ T, (F t / F t₀) ^ o = 1) ∧
    (∀ ξ : ℂ, ξ ^ o = 1 → o * (T.filter (fun t => F t = F t₀ * ξ)).card = T.card)

### PAG122::closed_of_unif（theorem、23 行）
theorem closed_of_unif {T : Finset α} {F : α → ℂ} {t₀ : α} {o : ℕ} (h : Unif T F t₀ o) :
    ∏ t ∈ T, (X - C (F t)) = (X ^ o - C (F t₀ ^ o)) ^ (T.card / o)

theorem dvd_card {T : Finset α} {F : α → ℂ} {t₀ : α} {o : ℕ} (h : Unif T F t₀ o) : o ∣ T.card

### PAG122::unif_smul（theorem、33 行）

theorem unif_smul {T : Finset α} {F : α → ℂ} {t₀ : α} {o : ℕ} (h : Unif T F t₀ o) (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Unif T (fun t => a * F t) t₀ o

### PAG122::card_mod_eq（theorem、46 行）
theorem card_mod_eq (o' g r : ℕ) (hr : r < o') :
    ((range (o' * g)).filter (fun j => j % o' = r)).card = g

### PAG122::unif_pow（theorem、68 行）
theorem unif_pow {T : Finset α} {F : α → ℂ} {t₀ : α} {o : ℕ} (h : Unif T F t₀ o) (k : ℕ) :
    Unif T (fun t => F t ^ k) t₀ (o / Nat.gcd o k)

### PAG122::ket_unif（theorem、169 行）
theorem ket_unif {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (K w n : ℕ) (h : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (t₀ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) :
    Unif (Tset (p := p) K (K - (n + 1) - w)) (fun t => 𝓕 (ket K w (n + 1) h χ) t) t₀ (orderOf χ)

### PAG122::charpoly_T12_closed（theorem、183 行）
theorem charpoly_T12_closed (K L w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (c₂ + 1) ≤ L)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (c₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (t₁ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁))
    (t₂ : ZMod (q ^ L)) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂)) :
    (T12 (p := p) (q := q) K L (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂) (by omega) (by omega)
        (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂)).charpoly
      = (X ^ Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂)
          - C ((𝓕 (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) t₁ * 𝓕 (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) t₂) ^ Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂)))
        ^ (sz p K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) * sz q L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂) / Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂))

### PAG123::unif_mul（theorem、19 行）
omit [DecidableEq β] in
theorem unif_mul {T₁ : Finset α} {T₂ : Finset β} {F₁ : α → ℂ} {F₂ : β → ℂ} {t₁ : α} {t₂ : β} {o₁ o₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁ : Unif T₁ F₁ t₁ o₁) (h₂ : Unif T₂ F₂ t₂ o₂) :
    Unif (T₁ ×ˢ T₂) (fun z => F₁ z.1 * F₂ z.2) (t₁, t₂) (Nat.lcm o₁ o₂)

### PAG123::ket_spec_unif（theorem、96 行）
theorem ket_spec_unif (K L w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (c₂ + 1) ≤ L)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (c₂ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (t₁ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁))
    (t₂ : ZMod (q ^ L)) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂)) :
    Unif (Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) ×ˢ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂))
      (fun z => 𝓕 (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) z.1 * 𝓕 (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) z.2) (t₁, t₂)
      (Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂))

### PAG123::ket_spec_unif3（theorem、107 行）
theorem ket_spec_unif3 (K L M w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ w₃ c₃ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (c₂ + 1) ≤ L)
    (h₃ : w₃ + (c₃ + 1) ≤ M)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (c₂ + 1)))
    (χ₃ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (r ^ (c₃ + 1)))

    (t₁ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁))
    (t₂ : ZMod (q ^ L)) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂))
    (t₃ : ZMod (r ^ M)) (ht₃ : t₃ ∈ Tset (p := r) M (M - (c₃ + 1) - w₃)) :
    Unif ((Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) ×ˢ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂)) ×ˢ
        Tset (p := r) M (M - (c₃ + 1) - w₃))
      (fun z => 𝓕 (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) z.1.1 * 𝓕 (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) z.1.2
        * 𝓕 (ket M w₃ (c₃ + 1) h₃ χ₃) z.2) ((t₁, t₂), t₃)

### PAG123::spec_poly3（theorem、123 行）
theorem spec_poly3 (K L M w₁ c₁ w₂ c₂ w₃ c₃ : ℕ) (h₁ : w₁ + (c₁ + 1) ≤ K) (h₂ : w₂ + (c₂ + 1) ≤ L)
    (h₃ : w₃ + (c₃ + 1) ≤ M)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (c₁ + 1))) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (c₂ + 1)))
    (χ₃ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (r ^ (c₃ + 1)))
    (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (hχ₃ : χ₃.IsPrimitive)
    (t₁ : ZMod (p ^ K)) (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁))
    (t₂ : ZMod (q ^ L)) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂))
    (t₃ : ZMod (r ^ M)) (ht₃ : t₃ ∈ Tset (p := r) M (M - (c₃ + 1) - w₃)) :
    ∏ z ∈ (Tset (p := p) K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) ×ˢ Tset (p := q) L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂)) ×ˢ
        Tset (p := r) M (M - (c₃ + 1) - w₃),
      (X - C (𝓕 (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) z.1.1 * 𝓕 (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) z.1.2
        * 𝓕 (ket M w₃ (c₃ + 1) h₃ χ₃) z.2))
      = (X ^ Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂)) (orderOf χ₃)
          - C ((𝓕 (ket K w₁ (c₁ + 1) h₁ χ₁) t₁ * 𝓕 (ket L w₂ (c₂ + 1) h₂ χ₂) t₂ * 𝓕 (ket M w₃ (c₃ + 1) h₃ χ₃) t₃)
            ^ Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂)) (orderOf χ₃)))
        ^ (sz p K (K - (c₁ + 1) - w₁) * sz q L (L - (c₂ + 1) - w₂) * sz r M (M - (c₃ + 1) - w₃)
            / Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm (orderOf χ₁) (orderOf χ₂)) (orderOf χ₃))

### PAG124::basisN（def、101 行）
noncomputable def basisN (ha : ∀ i, a i ≤ K i)
    (hcard : Fintype.card (Idxn p K a) = Module.finrank ℂ (Vn p K a)) :
    Module.Basis (Idxn p K a) ℂ (Vn p K a) :=
  basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank'
    (fun v => ⟨pchr (N := fun i => p i ^ K i) (fun i => (v i : ZMod (p i ^ K i))), pchr_mem p K a ha v⟩)
    (by
      apply LinearIndependent.of_comp (Vn p K a).subtype
      exact pchr_linearIndependent (N := fun i => p i ^ K i)
        (fun v : Idxn p K a => fun i => (v i : ZMod (p i ^ K i)))
        (fun v v' hv => funext fun i => Subtype.ext (congrFun hv i)))
    hcard

### PAG124::Tn（def、114 行）
noncomputable def Tn (ha : ∀ i, a i ≤ K i) (k : ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i) → ℂ) : Module.End ℂ (Vn p K a) :=
  (convL (ptens k)).restrict (fun f hf => by
    have hidem : conv (ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (a i))) (ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (a i)))
        = ptens (fun i => eps (p := p i) (K i) (a i)) := by
      rw [conv_ptens]; simp only [fun i => eps_idem (p := p i) (K i) (a i) (ha i)]
    exact (mem_range_convL _ hidem _).mpr (PAG.Part111.fix_conv _ _ f ((mem_range_convL _ hidem f).mp hf)))

### PAG125::lcmF（def、14 行）
def lcmF : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → ℕ) → ℕ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | n + 1, o => Nat.lcm (o 0) (lcmF n (fun i => o i.succ))

### PAG125::charpoly_Tn_closed（theorem、83 行）
theorem charpoly_Tn_closed (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (p i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)
    (t : ∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ K i)) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Tset (p := p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) :
    (Tn p K (fun i => K i - (c i + 1) - w i) (fun i => by omega)
        (fun i => ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i))).charpoly
      = (X ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))
          - C ((∏ i, 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i)) ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i))))
        ^ ((∏ i, sz (p i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)) / lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)))

      orderOf (gaussSum χ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ c) : ℝ) : ℂ))

### PAG136::ppart_div_gcd（theorem、16 行）
theorem ppart_div_gcd {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (a L E F : ℕ) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hL0 : L ≠ 0)
    (haE : p ^ E ∣ a) (haE' : ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ a) (hLF : p ^ F ∣ L) (hLF' : ¬ p ^ (F + 1) ∣ L) (hFE : F ≤ E) :
    p ^ (E - F) ∣ a / Nat.gcd a L ∧ ¬ p ^ (E - F + 1) ∣ a / Nat.gcd a L

### PAG136::ppart_prod（theorem、41 行）
theorem ppart_prod {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (z : ι → ℂ) (hz0 : ∀ j, orderOf (z j) ≠ 0) (i : ι) (E : ℕ)
    (hE : p ^ E ∣ orderOf (z i)) (hE' : ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf (z i))
    (hcond : ¬ p ^ E ∣ ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i, orderOf (z j)) :
    p ^ E ∣ orderOf (∏ j, z j) ∧ ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf (∏ j, z j)

### PAG136::ppart_prod_pow（theorem、63 行）
theorem ppart_prod_pow {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (z : ι → ℂ) (hz0 : ∀ j, orderOf (z j) ≠ 0) (i : ι) (E F L : ℕ)
    (hL0 : L ≠ 0) (hE : p ^ E ∣ orderOf (z i)) (hE' : ¬ p ^ (E + 1) ∣ orderOf (z i))
    (hcond : ¬ p ^ E ∣ ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i, orderOf (z j))
    (hLF : p ^ F ∣ L) (hLF' : ¬ p ^ (F + 1) ∣ L) (hFE : F ≤ E) :

### PAG136::zeta_prod_two_part（theorem、105 行）
theorem zeta_prod_two_part (hc : ∀ i, 1 ≤ c i) (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)

### PAG153::zeta_prod_small_two（theorem、57 行）
theorem zeta_prod_small_two (hc : ∀ i, 1 ≤ c i) (h : ∀ i, w i + (c i + 1) ≤ K i)
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (q i ^ (c i + 1))) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive)

    (hχj : ∀ j, j ≠ i → ¬ 2 ^ 2 ∣ orderOf (χ j)) :

    ¬ 4 ∣ orderOf ((∏ i, cnorm (q i) (K i) (K i - (c i + 1) - w i)
        * 𝓕 (ket (K i) (w i) (c i + 1) (h i) (χ i)) (t i)) ^ lcmF n (fun i => orderOf (χ i)))

### PAG160::quad_explicit（theorem、30 行）

    (hF : ∀ t s, F (t + s) = F t * F s * stdAddChar (a * t * s)) :
    ∃ κ : ZMod p, (∑ t, F t) / ((Real.sqrt p : ℝ) : ℂ) = stdAddChar κ * Lc p (a * 2⁻¹) * epsG p

### PAG164::count_three（theorem、72 行）
open Classical in
theorem count_three (h4 : p % 4 = 3) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    #{χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)) | χ.IsPrimitive ∧ orderOf (zeta n χ) = 4 * p}
        = (p - 1) * (p ^ (n - 1) * ((p - 1) / 2)) ∧
      #{χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)) | χ.IsPrimitive ∧ orderOf (zeta n χ) = 2 * p}

### PAG164::count_one（theorem、126 行）
open Classical in
theorem count_one (h4 : p % 4 = 1) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 = 2 * m + 1) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (v o : ℕ)
    (ho : Odd o) (hvo : p - 1 = 2 ^ v * o) :
    #{χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)) | χ.IsPrimitive ∧ orderOf (zeta n χ) = 2 * p}
        = (p - 1) / 2 * (p ^ (n - 1) * o) ∧
      #{χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1)) | χ.IsPrimitive ∧ orderOf (zeta n χ) = p}
        + (p - 1) / 2 * (p ^ (n - 1) * o) = p ^ (n - 1) * (p - 1) ^ 2

      = (Tpoly a b c d : ℂ)

def Rep2 (w : ℂ) (e e' : ZMod P) : Prop :=
  ∃ C D : ℤ, w = C + D * ω ∧ ((C : ZMod P) + D * μ = e) ∧ ((C : ZMod P) + D * (-1 - μ) = e')

### PAG180::Rep2_one（theorem、22 行）

### PAG180::Rep2_mul（theorem、24 行）

    (h : Rep2 μ w e e') (h' : Rep2 μ w' f f') : Rep2 μ (w * w') (e * f) (e' * f')

### PAG180::Rep2_pow（theorem、33 行）
theorem Rep2_pow (hμ : μ ^ 2 + μ + 1 = 0) {w : ℂ} {e e' : ZMod P} (h : Rep2 μ w e e') :
    ∀ m : ℕ, Rep2 μ (w ^ m) (e ^ m) (e' ^ m)
  | 0 => by simpa using Rep2_one
  | m + 1 => by rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, pow_succ]; exact Rep2_mul hμ (Rep2_pow hμ h m) h

### PAG185::chiA（def、185 行）
noncomputable def chiA (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) {μ : ℂ} (hμ : IsPrimitiveRoot μ (orderOf χ)) :
    MulChar (ZMod p) (Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({μ} : Set ℂ)) where
  toFun x := ⟨χ x, by
    have : NeZero (orderOf χ) := ⟨(orderOf_pos_chi χ).ne'⟩
    exact MulChar.apply_mem_algebraAdjoin_of_pow_eq_one (pow_orderOf_eq_one χ) hμ x⟩
  map_one' := Subtype.ext (map_one χ)
  map_mul' x y := Subtype.ext (map_mul χ x y)
  map_nonunit' x hx := Subtype.ext (χ.map_nonunit hx)

### PAG189::jacobi_pair（theorem、223 行）
theorem jacobi_pair (hval : χA.ringHomComp A.val.toRingHom = χ) (i : ℕ) (hi1 : 1 ≤ i)
    (hi2 : i + 2 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i) * jacobiSum (χA ^ (orderOf χ - 1)) (χA ^ (orderOf χ - i)) = (p : A)

### PAG189::val_jacobi（theorem、247 行）
theorem val_jacobi (hc : c.Coprime (orderOf χ)) (i : ℕ) (hi1 : 1 ≤ i) (hi2 : i + 2 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    ι (jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i)) ≠ 0 ∧
      (ι (jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i))).valuation
        = if c % orderOf χ + c * i % orderOf χ < orderOf χ then 1 else 0

### PAG189::val_QA（theorem、295 行）
theorem val_QA (hc : c.Coprime (orderOf χ)) (j : ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j + 1 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    ι (∏ i ∈ Ico 1 j, jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i)) ≠ 0 ∧
      (orderOf χ : ℤ) * (ι (∏ i ∈ Ico 1 j, jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i))).valuation
        = ((j : ℤ) - 1) * orderOf χ - j * ((c % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)
          + ((c * j % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)

### PAG189::val_PA（theorem、331 行）
theorem val_PA (hc : c.Coprime (orderOf χ)) (hn : 2 ≤ orderOf χ) :
    ι (∏ i ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ - 1), jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i)) ≠ 0 ∧
      ((ι (∏ i ∈ Ico 1 (orderOf χ - 1), jacobiSum χA (χA ^ i))).valuation : ℤ)
        = orderOf χ - 1 - ((c % orderOf χ : ℕ) : ℤ)

### PAG189::W_eq（theorem、363 行）
theorem W_eq (χ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hn : 2 ≤ orderOf χ) {ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ}
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (j : ℕ) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j < orderOf χ) :

### PAG189::same_prime_necessary（theorem、388 行）

### PAG194::comp₁（def、59 行）
noncomputable def comp₁ (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (N₁ * N₂)) :
    DirichletCharacter ℂ N₁ where
  toFun a := χ ((crt hcop).symm (a, 1))
  map_one' := by
    show χ ((crt hcop).symm 1) = 1
    rw [map_one, map_one]
  map_mul' a b := by
    show χ ((crt hcop).symm (a * b, 1)) = χ ((crt hcop).symm (a, 1)) * χ ((crt hcop).symm (b, 1))
    rw [show ((a * b, 1) : ZMod N₁ × ZMod N₂) = (a, 1) * (b, 1) by simp, map_mul, map_mul]
  map_nonunit' a ha := by
    apply MulChar.map_nonunit
    intro hu
    apply ha
    have := hu.map (crt hcop)
    rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
    exact (Prod.isUnit_iff.mp this).1

### PAG194::comp₂（def、77 行）
noncomputable def comp₂ (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (N₁ * N₂)) :
    DirichletCharacter ℂ N₂ where
  toFun b := χ ((crt hcop).symm (1, b))
  map_one' := by
    show χ ((crt hcop).symm 1) = 1
    rw [map_one, map_one]
  map_mul' a b := by
    show χ ((crt hcop).symm (1, a * b)) = χ ((crt hcop).symm (1, a)) * χ ((crt hcop).symm (1, b))
    rw [show ((1, a * b) : ZMod N₁ × ZMod N₂) = (1, a) * (1, b) by simp, map_mul, map_mul]
  map_nonunit' b hb := by
    apply MulChar.map_nonunit
    intro hu
    apply hb
    have := hu.map (crt hcop)
    rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
    exact (Prod.isUnit_iff.mp this).2

    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hn : 3 ≤ orderOf χ₁) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ((gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      (gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar / ((Real.sqrt (M : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) ^ N ≠ 1

### PAG194::peel_root_iff（theorem、371 行）
theorem peel_root_iff {p M : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [NeZero M] (e : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (hcop : (p ^ e).Coprime M) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ e)) (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (gaussSum (χ₁.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right (p ^ e) M) *
        χ₂.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left M (p ^ e))) stdAddChar /
          ((Real.sqrt ((p ^ e * M : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ N = 1) ↔
      (2 ≤ e ∨ orderOf χ₁ = 2) ∧

### PAG194::two_prime_power_root_iff（theorem、414 行）

    (he : 1 ≤ e) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hcop : (p ^ e).Coprime (q ^ f))
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ e * q ^ f)) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    (∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧

      (2 ≤ e ∨ orderOf (comp₁ hcop χ) = 2) ∧ (2 ≤ f ∨ orderOf (comp₂ hcop χ) = 2)

### PAG196::hall（def、70 行）
noncomputable def hall {N : ℕ} (A B : ℕ) [NeZero A] [NeZero B] (hAB : A * B = N)
    (hcop : A.Coprime B) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : DirichletCharacter ℂ A where
  toFun a := χ (lift A B hAB hcop a)
  map_one' := by
    show χ (lift A B hAB hcop 1) = 1
    have hA : A ∣ N := ⟨B, hAB.symm⟩
    have hB : B ∣ N := ⟨A, by rw [← hAB, mul_comm]⟩
    have h1 := eq_lift A B hAB hcop hA hB 1 (map_one _)
    rw [map_one] at h1
    rw [h1, map_one]
  map_mul' a b := by
    show χ (lift A B hAB hcop (a * b)) = χ (lift A B hAB hcop a) * χ (lift A B hAB hcop b)
    have hA : A ∣ N := ⟨B, hAB.symm⟩
    have hB : B ∣ N := ⟨A, by rw [← hAB, mul_comm]⟩
    have ha := lift_spec A B hAB hcop hA hB a
    have hb := lift_spec A B hAB hcop hA hB b
    have h1 := eq_lift A B hAB hcop hA hB (lift A B hAB hcop a * lift A B hAB hcop b)
      (by rw [map_mul, ha.2, hb.2, mul_one])
    rw [map_mul, ha.1, hb.1] at h1
    rw [h1, map_mul]
  map_nonunit' a ha := by
    apply MulChar.map_nonunit
    intro hu
    apply ha
    have hA : A ∣ N := ⟨B, hAB.symm⟩
    have hB : B ∣ N := ⟨A, by rw [← hAB, mul_comm]⟩
    have := hu.map (ZMod.castHom hA (ZMod A))
    rwa [(lift_spec A B hAB hcop hA hB a).1] at this

### PAG196::pcomp（def、211 行）
noncomputable def pcomp (q : ℕ) [hq : Fact q.Prime] {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    DirichletCharacter ℂ q :=
  if h : q ∣ N ∧ ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N then
    haveI : NeZero (N / q) := ⟨(pcomp_aux hq.out h).1.ne'⟩
    hall q (N / q) (Nat.mul_div_cancel' h.1) (pcomp_aux hq.out h).2 χ
  else 1

### PAG197::family_regroup（theorem、24 行）
theorem family_regroup {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (ω : DirichletCharacter ℂ p) {κ : Type*}
    (s : Finset κ) (k : κ → ℕ) (hk : ∀ t ∈ s, ¬ orderOf ω ∣ k t) (b : κ → ℤ) :
    ∏ t ∈ s, zN (ω ^ k t) ^ b t =

### PAG197::LocalCrit（def、198 行）
def LocalCrit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → ℕ) (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i))
    (a : ι → ℤ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime], ∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧
    (∏ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => q ∣ N i ∧ ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N i), zN (pcomp q (χ i)) ^ a i) ^ K = 1

### PAG197::localProd_congr（theorem、204 行）
theorem localProd_congr {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → ℕ) (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i))
    (a : ι → ℤ) {q q' : ℕ} (h : q = q') [Fact q.Prime] [Fact q'.Prime] :
    ∏ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => q ∣ N i ∧ ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N i), zN (pcomp q (χ i)) ^ a i =
      ∏ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => q' ∣ N i ∧ ¬ q' ^ 2 ∣ N i), zN (pcomp q' (χ i)) ^ a i

      ∀ (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i)), (∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) →
        ((∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (∏ i, zN (χ i) ^ a i) ^ K = 1) ↔ LocalCrit N χ a)

### PAG197::prod_root_iff_local（theorem、405 行）
theorem prod_root_iff_local {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → ℕ) [hN : ∀ i, NeZero (N i)]
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i)) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) (a : ι → ℤ) :
    (∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (∏ i, zN (χ i) ^ a i) ^ K = 1) ↔ LocalCrit N χ a

### PAG197::local_root_iff（theorem、413 行）
theorem local_root_iff {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (ω : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hω : orderOf ω = q - 1)
    {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (k : κ → ℕ) (hk : ∀ t ∈ s, ¬ (q - 1) ∣ k t) (b : κ → ℤ) :
    (∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (∏ t ∈ s, zN (ω ^ k t) ^ b t) ^ K = 1) ↔
      ∀ c : ℕ, c.Coprime (q - 1) →
        ∑ t ∈ s, b t * (((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * k t % (q - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0

### PAG197::prod_root_iff_stickelberger（theorem、425 行）
theorem prod_root_iff_stickelberger {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → ℕ) [∀ i, NeZero (N i)]
    (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i)) (hχ : ∀ i, (χ i).IsPrimitive) (a : ι → ℤ)
    (ω : ∀ q : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hω : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → orderOf (ω q) = q - 1)
    (k : ι → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hk : ∀ (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime] (i : ι), q ∣ N i → ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N i → pcomp q (χ i) = ω q ^ k i q) :
    (∃ K : ℕ, 0 < K ∧ (∏ i, zN (χ i) ^ a i) ^ K = 1) ↔
      ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → ∀ c : ℕ, c.Coprime (q - 1) →
        ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => q ∣ N i ∧ ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N i),
          a i * (((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 2 * ((c * k i q % (q - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0

### PAG197::exists_stickelberger_data（theorem、467 行）
theorem exists_stickelberger_data {ι : Type*} (N : ι → ℕ) (χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i)) :
    ∃ (ω : ∀ q : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (k : ι → ℕ → ℕ),
      (∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → orderOf (ω q) = q - 1) ∧
      (∀ (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime] (i : ι), pcomp q (χ i) = ω q ^ k i q)

### PAG199::gket（def、83 行）
noncomputable def gket (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M) (χ : ZMod c → ℂ) :
    ZMod N → ℂ :=

  (((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    PAG.Part17.push (memb u M N h) (χ ∘ (ZMod.castHom hc (ZMod c)).toAddMonoidHom)

### PAG199::cmul_apply（theorem、147 行）

    (X₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (x : ZMod (c₁ * c₂)) :

### PAG199::gket_crt（theorem、158 行）
theorem gket_crt (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N₁) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N₂)
    (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (X₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (X₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (x : ZMod (N₁ * N₂)) :
    X₁ (u₂ : ZMod c₁) * X₂ (u₁ : ZMod c₂) *
        gket (u₁ * u₂) (M₁ * M₂) (N₁ * N₂) (by rw [← h₁, ← h₂]; ring) (c₁ * c₂) (mul_dvd_mul hc₁ hc₂)
          (cmul X₁ X₂) x
      = gket u₁ M₁ N₁ h₁ c₁ hc₁ X₁ (ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right N₁ N₂) (ZMod N₁) x) *
        gket u₂ M₂ N₂ h₂ c₂ hc₂ X₂ (ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_left N₂ N₁) (ZMod N₂) x)

### PAG199::gauss_ratio_mul（theorem、229 行）
theorem gauss_ratio_mul {c₁ c₂ d₁ d₂ : ℕ} [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] [NeZero d₁] [NeZero d₂]
    (hcop : c₁.Coprime c₂)
    (hd₁ : d₁ ∣ c₁) (hd₂ : d₂ ∣ c₂)
    (A₁ B₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (A₂ B₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂)
    (Ψ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₁) (Ψ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₂)
    (hΨ₁ : A₁ * B₁ = Ψ₁.changeLevel hd₁) (hΨ₂ : A₂ * B₂ = Ψ₂.changeLevel hd₂) :
    gaussSum (cmul A₁ A₂) stdAddChar * gaussSum (cmul B₁ B₂) stdAddChar / gaussSum (cmul Ψ₁ Ψ₂) stdAddChar
      = Ψ₁ ((c₂ / d₂ : ℕ) : ZMod d₁) * Ψ₂ ((c₁ / d₁ : ℕ) : ZMod d₂) *
        (gaussSum A₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum B₁ stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ₁ stdAddChar) *
        (gaussSum A₂ stdAddChar * gaussSum B₂ stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ₂ stdAddChar)

theorem gket_crt_fun (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N₁) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N₂)
    (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂) (X₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (X₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) :

          (PAG.Part194.crt hcop).toAddEquiv

### PAG199::thmA_mul_aux（theorem、301 行）
theorem thmA_mul_aux (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N₁) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N₂)
    (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂) {u₁' u₂' M₁' M₂' d₁ d₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁' : u₁' * M₁' = N₁) (h₂' : u₂' * M₂' = N₂) (hd₁ : d₁ ∣ M₁') (hd₂ : d₂ ∣ M₂')
    (hdc₁ : d₁ ∣ c₁) (hdc₂ : d₂ ∣ c₂) (hu₁' : u₁' = u₁ * (c₁ / d₁)) (hu₂' : u₂' = u₂ * (c₂ / d₂))
    (A₁ B₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (A₂ B₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂)
    (Ψ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₁) (Ψ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₂)
    (hΨ₁ : A₁ * B₁ = Ψ₁.changeLevel hdc₁) (hΨ₂ : A₂ * B₂ = Ψ₂.changeLevel hdc₂) (l₁ l₂ : ℂ)
    (H₁ : PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N₁ h₁ c₁ hc₁ A₁) (gket u₁ M₁ N₁ h₁ c₁ hc₁ B₁)
      = l₁ • gket u₁' M₁' N₁ h₁' d₁ hd₁ Ψ₁)
    (H₂ : PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₂ M₂ N₂ h₂ c₂ hc₂ A₂) (gket u₂ M₂ N₂ h₂ c₂ hc₂ B₂)
      = l₂ • gket u₂' M₂' N₂ h₂' d₂ hd₂ Ψ₂) :
    PAG.Part15.conv
        (gket (u₁ * u₂) (M₁ * M₂) (N₁ * N₂) (prod_eq h₁ h₂) (c₁ * c₂) (mul_dvd_mul hc₁ hc₂) (cmul A₁ A₂))
        (gket (u₁ * u₂) (M₁ * M₂) (N₁ * N₂) (prod_eq h₁ h₂) (c₁ * c₂) (mul_dvd_mul hc₁ hc₂) (cmul B₁ B₂))
      = (Ψ₁ ((c₂ / d₂ : ℕ) : ZMod d₁) * Ψ₂ ((c₁ / d₁ : ℕ) : ZMod d₂) * l₁ * l₂) •
        gket (u₁' * u₂') (M₁' * M₂') (N₁ * N₂) (prod_eq h₁' h₂') (d₁ * d₂) (mul_dvd_mul hd₁ hd₂)
          (cmul Ψ₁ Ψ₂)

### PAG199::thmAConst（def、363 行）
noncomputable def thmAConst (N u c d : ℕ) [NeZero c] [NeZero d] (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) : ℂ :=
  ((Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ) / (Nat.totient (u * c) : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    (gaussSum A stdAddChar * gaussSum B stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar) /
      ((Real.sqrt ((c * (c / d) : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)

### PAG199::thmAConst_mul（theorem、370 行）
theorem thmAConst_mul {N₁ N₂ u₁ u₂ M₁ M₂ c₁ c₂ d₁ d₂ : ℕ} [NeZero N₁] [NeZero N₂]
    [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] [NeZero d₁] [NeZero d₂]
    (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N₁) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N₂) (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (hdc₁ : d₁ ∣ c₁) (hdc₂ : d₂ ∣ c₂)
    (A₁ B₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (A₂ B₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂)
    (Ψ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₁) (Ψ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d₂)
    (hΨ₁ : A₁ * B₁ = Ψ₁.changeLevel hdc₁) (hΨ₂ : A₂ * B₂ = Ψ₂.changeLevel hdc₂) :
    Ψ₁ ((c₂ / d₂ : ℕ) : ZMod d₁) * Ψ₂ ((c₁ / d₁ : ℕ) : ZMod d₂) * thmAConst N₁ u₁ c₁ d₁ A₁ B₁ Ψ₁ *
        thmAConst N₂ u₂ c₂ d₂ A₂ B₂ Ψ₂
      = thmAConst (N₁ * N₂) (u₁ * u₂) (c₁ * c₂) (d₁ * d₂) (cmul A₁ A₂) (cmul B₁ B₂) (cmul Ψ₁ Ψ₂)

### PAG199::ThmA（def、404 行）
def ThmA (N u M c d u' M' : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] [NeZero d] (h : u * M = N) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (h' : u' * M' = N) (hd : d ∣ M')
    (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) : Prop :=
  PAG.Part15.conv (gket u M N h c hc A) (gket u M N h c hc B) = thmAConst N u c d A B Ψ • gket u' M' N h' d hd Ψ

### PAG199::thmA_prime_power（theorem、410 行）
theorem thmA_prime_power {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : χ₁ * χ₂ = ψ.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v))) :
    ThmA (p ^ K) (p ^ w) (p ^ (K - w)) (p ^ (n + 1)) (p ^ (n + 1 - v)) (p ^ (w + v)) (p ^ (K - (w + v)))
      (pow_mul_pow_sub p (by omega)) (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) (pow_mul_pow_sub p (by omega))
      (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) χ₁ χ₂ ψ

### PAG199::thmA_mul（theorem、440 行）
theorem thmA_mul {N₁ N₂ u₁ u₂ M₁ M₂ c₁ c₂ d₁ d₂ u₁' u₂' M₁' M₂' : ℕ} [NeZero N₁] [NeZero N₂]

    (hdc₁ : d₁ ∣ c₁) (hdc₂ : d₂ ∣ c₂) (hu₁' : u₁' = u₁ * (c₁ / d₁)) (hu₂' : u₂' = u₂ * (c₂ / d₂))

    (H₁ : ThmA N₁ u₁ M₁ c₁ d₁ u₁' M₁' h₁ hc₁ h₁' hd₁ A₁ B₁ Ψ₁)

### PAG199::thmA_two_prime（theorem、460 行）
theorem thmA_two_prime {p q : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [hq : Fact q.Prime] (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (K w n v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ n) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K)
    (L w' m v' : ℕ) (hv' : v' ≤ m) (hL : w' + (m + 1) ≤ L)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (h₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive) (h₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1 - v))) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : χ₁ * χ₂ = ψ.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.sub_le (n + 1) v)))
    (η₁ η₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (m + 1))) (g₁ : η₁.IsPrimitive) (g₂ : η₂.IsPrimitive)
    (ψ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (m + 1 - v'))) (hψ' : ψ'.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod' : η₁ * η₂ = ψ'.changeLevel (pow_dvd_pow q (Nat.sub_le (m + 1) v'))) :
    ThmA (p ^ K * q ^ L) (p ^ w * q ^ w') (p ^ (K - w) * q ^ (L - w')) (p ^ (n + 1) * q ^ (m + 1))
      (p ^ (n + 1 - v) * q ^ (m + 1 - v')) (p ^ (w + v) * q ^ (w' + v'))
      (p ^ (K - (w + v)) * q ^ (L - (w' + v')))
      (prod_eq (pow_mul_pow_sub p (by omega)) (pow_mul_pow_sub q (by omega)))
      (mul_dvd_mul (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) (pow_dvd_pow q (by omega)))
      (prod_eq (pow_mul_pow_sub p (by omega)) (pow_mul_pow_sub q (by omega)))
      (mul_dvd_mul (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) (pow_dvd_pow q (by omega)))
      (cmul χ₁ η₁) (cmul χ₂ η₂) (cmul ψ ψ')

### PAG199::normSq_gket_crt（theorem、500 行）
theorem normSq_gket_crt {N₁ N₂ u₁ u₂ M₁ M₂ c₁ c₂ : ℕ} [NeZero N₁] [NeZero N₂]
    (hcop : N₁.Coprime N₂) (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N₁) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N₂)
    (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂) (X₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (X₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq
        (gket (u₁ * u₂) (M₁ * M₂) (N₁ * N₂) (prod_eq h₁ h₂) (c₁ * c₂) (mul_dvd_mul hc₁ hc₂) (cmul X₁ X₂) x)
      = (∑ x, Complex.normSq (gket u₁ M₁ N₁ h₁ c₁ hc₁ X₁ x)) *

### PAG199::norm_gket_two_prime（theorem、532 行）
theorem norm_gket_two_prime {p q : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [hq : Fact q.Prime] (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (K w n : ℕ) (hK : w + (n + 1) ≤ K) (L w' m : ℕ) (hL : w' + (m + 1) ≤ L)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p ^ (n + 1))) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (η : DirichletCharacter ℂ (q ^ (m + 1))) (hη : η.IsPrimitive) :
    ∑ x, Complex.normSq (gket (p ^ w * q ^ w') (p ^ (K - w) * q ^ (L - w')) (p ^ K * q ^ L)
      (prod_eq (pow_mul_pow_sub p (by omega)) (pow_mul_pow_sub q (by omega))) (p ^ (n + 1) * q ^ (m + 1))
      (mul_dvd_mul (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) (pow_dvd_pow q (by omega))) (cmul χ η) x) = 1

### PAG201::gket_pull（theorem、85 行）
theorem gket_pull (u M N t : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero t] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : ZMod c → ℂ) :
    pull (dvd_mul_right N t) (gket u M N h c hc χ)
      = ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (M * t)) / Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        gket u (M * t) (N * t) (by rw [← h, mul_assoc]) c (hc.trans (dvd_mul_right M t)) χ

### PAG201::zket（def、131 行）
noncomputable def zket (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) (hc : c ∣ M) (χ : ZMod c → ℂ) :
    ZMod N → ℂ :=
  ((Real.sqrt N : ℝ) : ℂ) • gket u M N h c hc χ

### PAG201::zket_pull（theorem、140 行）

### PAG201::zket_apply（theorem、159 行）

### PAG201::jt（def、191 行）

### PAG204::conv_mixed（theorem、234 行）
theorem conv_mixed (u₁ M₁ u₂ M₂ N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N)
    (c₁ c₂ d : ℕ) [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] [NeZero d] (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (hdL : d ∣ Nat.lcm c₁ c₂)
    (A : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (B : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d)
    (hA : A.IsPrimitive) (hB : B.IsPrimitive) (hΨ : Ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hprod : A.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_left c₁ c₂) * B.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_lcm_right c₁ c₂) =
      Ψ.changeLevel hdL) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N h₁ c₁ hc₁ A) (gket u₂ M₂ N h₂ c₂ hc₂ B) =
      (((Nat.gcd (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ℂ) /
          ((Real.sqrt ((Nat.totient M₁ : ℝ) * (Nat.totient M₂ : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (A⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₁ / c₁) : ℕ) : ZMod c₁) *
          B⁻¹ ((Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ZMod c₂)) *
        (gaussSum A stdAddChar * gaussSum B stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar)) •
      ∑ e ∈ (Nat.lcm c₁ c₂).divisors.filter (fun e => e.Coprime d),
        ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * Ψ⁻¹ (e : ZMod d) / (e : ℂ)) •
          rk (N := N) (N / (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) * d * e)) d Ψ

    (hcop₂ : (Nat.lcm (M₁ / c₁) (M₂ / c₂) / (M₂ / c₂)).Coprime c₂) :

          ((Real.sqrt ((Nat.totient M₁ : ℝ) * (Nat.totient M₂ : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *

        (gaussSum A stdAddChar * gaussSum B stdAddChar / gaussSum Ψ stdAddChar))) =

          ((c₁ : ℝ) * c₂) / ((Nat.totient M₁ : ℝ) * Nat.totient M₂ * d)

      if Nat.gcd n y = 1 then 1 else 0

### PAG206::oldP_gket（theorem、279 行）

### PAG209::dft_gket_apply'（theorem、27 行）

      (kcoef M c χ * χ⁻¹ ((s / (M / c) : ℕ) : ZMod c)) • gbas s (N / s) N (liftc χ⁻¹ (N / s))

### PAG210::conv_gket_gket（theorem、146 行）
theorem conv_gket_gket (u₁ M₁ u₂ M₂ N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h₁ : u₁ * M₁ = N) (h₂ : u₂ * M₂ = N)
    (c₁ c₂ : ℕ) [NeZero c₁] [NeZero c₂] (hc₁ : c₁ ∣ M₁) (hc₂ : c₂ ∣ M₂)
    (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₁) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c₂) (hχ₁ : χ₁.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ₂ : χ₂.IsPrimitive) :
    PAG.Part15.conv (gket u₁ M₁ N h₁ c₁ hc₁ χ₁) (gket u₂ M₂ N h₂ c₂ hc₂ χ₂) =
      ∑ s ∈ N.divisors.filter
          (fun s => M₁ / c₁ ∣ s ∧ s / (M₁ / c₁) ∣ u₁ ∧ M₂ / c₂ ∣ s ∧ s / (M₂ / c₂) ∣ u₂),
        (kcoef M₁ c₁ χ₁ * χ₁⁻¹ ((s / (M₁ / c₁) : ℕ) : ZMod c₁) *
          (kcoef M₂ c₂ χ₂ * χ₂⁻¹ ((s / (M₂ / c₂) : ℕ) : ZMod c₂))) •
          gbas s (N / s) N (liftc χ₁⁻¹ (N / s) * liftc χ₂⁻¹ (N / s))

### PAG210::kcoef_mul_kcoef_inv（theorem、181 行）

### PAG211::gaussSum_changeLevel_apply（theorem、214 行）

### PAG212::kdual（def、151 行）

        ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (N / (N / u / c / e)) : ℂ))) •

### PAG213::inner_gket_block（theorem、156 行）
theorem inner_gket_block (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u' M' : ℕ) (h' : u' * M' = N) (hc' : c ∣ M') :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gket u M N h c hc χ x) * gket u' M' N h' c hc' χ x =
      ∑ t ∈ u.divisors.filter (fun t => t.Coprime c),
        starRingEnd ℂ (kcoef M c χ * χ⁻¹ (t : ZMod c)) *
          (if M' / c ∣ M / c * t ∧ M / c * t / (M' / c) ∣ u' then
            kcoef M' c χ * χ⁻¹ ((M / c * t / (M' / c) : ℕ) : ZMod c) *
              ((Nat.totient (u / t * c) : ℂ) / N)
          else 0)

### PAG213::inner_gket_block_gcd（theorem、172 行）
theorem inner_gket_block_gcd (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (hc : c ∣ M)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u' M' : ℕ) (h' : u' * M' = N) (hc' : c ∣ M') :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gket u M N h c hc χ x) * gket u' M' N h' c hc' χ x =
      starRingEnd ℂ (kcoef M c χ) * kcoef M' c χ / N *
        ∑ v ∈ (Nat.gcd u u').divisors,
          χ ((u / v : ℕ) : ZMod c) * χ⁻¹ ((u' / v : ℕ) : ZMod c) * (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ)

### PAG213::inner_gket_ball（theorem、230 行）
theorem inner_gket_ball (u M N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : u * M = N) (u' M' : ℕ) (h' : u' * M' = N) :
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gket u M N h 1 (one_dvd M) (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) x) *
        gket u' M' N h' 1 (one_dvd M') (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) x =
      (M : ℂ) * M' * (Nat.gcd u u' : ℂ) /
        (((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient M') : ℝ) : ℂ) * N)

### PAG213::blockGram（def、370 行）
noncomputable def blockGram (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    Matrix (N / c).divisors (N / c).divisors ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun u u' =>
    ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gket u (N / u) N (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (block_dvd hcN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u.2)).1) c
        (block_dvd hcN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u.2)).2 χ x) *
      gket u' (N / u') N (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (block_dvd hcN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u'.2)).1) c
        (block_dvd hcN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u'.2)).2 χ x

    ZMod N → ℂ :=

### PAG215::normSq_kdual（theorem、235 行）
theorem normSq_kdual (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (u : (N / c).divisors) :
    ((∑ x, Complex.normSq (kdual N u c χ x) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      (N : ℂ) / (Complex.normSq (kcoef (N / u) c χ) : ℂ) *
        ∑ v ∈ (N / c).divisors.filter (fun v => (u : ℕ) ∣ v),
          (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (v / u) : ℂ) ^ 2 * (Complex.normSq (χ ((v / u : ℕ) : ZMod c)) : ℂ) /
            (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ)

### PAG215::kdual_eq_sum_gblock（theorem、269 行）

    (u : (N / c).divisors) :
    kdual N u c χ = ∑ v ∈ (N / c).divisors.filter (fun v => (u : ℕ) ∣ v),
      starRingEnd ℂ ((kcoef (N / u) c χ)⁻¹ * ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (v / u) : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ ((v / u : ℕ) : ZMod c)) *
        ((N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (v * c) : ℂ))) • gblock N c χ v

### PAG215::BlockIdx（abbrev、554 行）
abbrev BlockIdx (N : ℕ) : Type :=
  Σ c : N.divisors, {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive}

### PAG215::blockProjI（def、558 行）
noncomputable def blockProjI (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (b : BlockIdx N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) : ZMod N → ℂ :=
  @blockProj N b.1 _ ⟨(Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors b.1.2).ne'⟩ b.2.1 f

### PAG215::blockEquiv（def、562 行）
def blockEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : (Σ b : BlockIdx N, (N / (b.1 : ℕ)).divisors) ≃ KetIdx N where
  toFun p := blockIdx N p.1.1 (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors p.1.1.2) p.1.2.1 p.1.2.2 p.2
  invFun i := ⟨⟨⟨i.2.1, ((mem_block_iff N i.1 i.2.1 (NeZero.ne N)).mp ⟨i.1.2, i.2.1.2⟩).1⟩, i.2.2⟩,
    ⟨i.1, ((mem_block_iff N i.1 i.2.1 (NeZero.ne N)).mp ⟨i.1.2, i.2.1.2⟩).2⟩⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

### PAG215::sum_blockProjI（theorem、570 行）
theorem sum_blockProjI (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] (f : ZMod N → ℂ) :
    f = ∑ b : BlockIdx N, blockProjI N b f

### PAG217::fcoef（def、63 行）
noncomputable def fcoef (N c : ℕ) [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (u : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ((Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (u * c)) / Real.sqrt (Nat.totient (N / u)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((N / u / c : ℕ) : ℂ) *
    χ⁻¹ (-1) * gaussSum χ stdAddChar

### PAG218::blockProjL（def、151 行）
noncomputable def blockProjL (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun := blockProj N c χ
  map_add' f g := by
    simp only [blockProj, Pi.add_apply, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_smul]
  map_smul' r f := by
    simp only [blockProj, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => by ring)

### PAG219::ShellInvariant（def、183 行）

  ∀ s : ℕ, ∀ f ∈ W, PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f ∈ W ∧ dind N s * f ∈ W

### PAG219::BlockIrreducible（def、187 行）
def BlockIrreducible (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : Prop :=
  ∀ W : Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ), ShellInvariant W → W ≤ blockSpan N c χ → W = ⊥ ∨ W = blockSpan N c χ

### PAG219::pPart（def、282 行）
noncomputable def pPart (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (p : ℕ) :
    Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  carrier := {f | f ∈ blockSpan N c χ ∧ ∀ x : ZMod N, p ∣ x.val → f x = 0}
  add_mem' := fun ha hb => ⟨add_mem ha.1 hb.1, fun x hx => by
    rw [Pi.add_apply, ha.2 x hx, hb.2 x hx, add_zero]⟩
  zero_mem' := ⟨zero_mem _, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  smul_mem' := fun r {f} hf => ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ r hf.1, fun x hx => by
    rw [Pi.smul_apply, hf.2 x hx, smul_zero]⟩

### PAG220::block_decomposition（theorem、540 行）
theorem block_decomposition (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) :
    iSupIndep (fun d : layerIdx c (N / c) => layerPart N c χ (d : ℕ)) ∧
      (⨆ d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c), layerPart N c χ d) = blockSpan N c χ ∧
      (∀ d ∈ layerIdx c (N / c), layerPart N c χ d ≠ ⊥ ∧ ShellInvariant (layerPart N c χ d) ∧
        ∀ W : Submodule ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ), ShellInvariant W → W ≤ layerPart N c χ d →
          W = ⊥ ∨ W = layerPart N c χ d) ∧
      (layerIdx c (N / c)).card = ∏ p ∈ (Nat.gcd c (N / c)).primeFactors, ((N / c).factorization p + 1)

### PAG221::blockComm（def、451 行）
noncomputable def blockComm (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) :
    Submodule ℂ (Module.End ℂ (blockSpan N c χ)) where
  carrier := {T | ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ),
    (∀ h : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
      (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ h : dind N s * f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
      (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = dind N s * (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ))}
  add_mem' := by
    intro T₁ T₂ h₁ h₂
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    intro s f hf
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_add, (h₁ s f hf).1 h,
        (h₂ s f hf).1 h, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_add]
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_add, (h₁ s f hf).2 h,
        (h₂ s f hf).2 h, mul_add]
  zero_mem' := by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    intro s f hf
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_zero]
    · rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, mul_zero]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro r T hT
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hT ⊢
    intro s f hf
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, Submodule.coe_smul, (hT s f hf).1 h,
        ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_smul]
    · rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, Submodule.coe_smul, (hT s f hf).2 h,
        mul_smul_comm]

### PAG221::mem_blockComm（theorem、484 行）
theorem mem_blockComm (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (T : Module.End ℂ (blockSpan N c χ)) :
    T ∈ blockComm N c χ ↔ ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ),
      (∀ h : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
        (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ h : dind N s * f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
        (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = dind N s * (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ))

### PAG221::blockExt（def、497 行）

### PAG222::twistFn（def、28 行）
noncomputable def twistFn (N c : ℕ) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) : ZMod N → ℂ :=

### PAG222::block_twist_iso（theorem、293 行）
theorem block_twist_iso (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) :
    (∀ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ, twistFn N c χ χ' * f ∈ blockSpan N c χ') ∧
    (∀ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ, twistFn N c χ' χ * (twistFn N c χ χ' * f) = f) ∧
    (∀ g ∈ blockSpan N c χ', twistFn N c χ χ' * (twistFn N c χ' χ * g) = g) ∧
    (∀ (s : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ blockSpan N c χ, twistFn N c χ χ' * PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f =
      PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (twistFn N c χ χ' * f)) ∧
    (∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), twistFn N c χ χ' * (dind N s * f) = dind N s * (twistFn N c χ χ' * f)) ∧
    (∀ (d : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ layerPart N c χ d, twistFn N c χ χ' * f ∈ layerPart N c χ' d)

### PAG222::blockHom（def、310 行）
noncomputable def blockHom (N c c' : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c') :
    Submodule ℂ (blockSpan N c χ →ₗ[ℂ] blockSpan N c' χ') where
  carrier := {T | ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ),
    (∀ h : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
      (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ h : dind N s * f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
      (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = dind N s * (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ))}
  add_mem' := by
    intro T₁ T₂ h₁ h₂
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    intro s f hf
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_add, (h₁ s f hf).1 h,
        (h₂ s f hf).1 h, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_add]
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_add, (h₁ s f hf).2 h,
        (h₂ s f hf).2 h, mul_add]
  zero_mem' := by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    intro s f hf
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_zero]
    · rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, mul_zero]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro r T hT
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hT ⊢
    intro s f hf
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, Submodule.coe_smul, (hT s f hf).1 h,
        ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_smul]
    · rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, Submodule.coe_smul, (hT s f hf).2 h,
        mul_smul_comm]

### PAG222::mem_blockHom（theorem、343 行）
theorem mem_blockHom (N c c' : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ c')
    (T : blockSpan N c χ →ₗ[ℂ] blockSpan N c' χ') :
    T ∈ blockHom N c c' χ χ' ↔ ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (hf : f ∈ blockSpan N c χ),
      (∀ h : PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
        (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ h : dind N s * f ∈ blockSpan N c χ,
        (T ⟨_, h⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ) = dind N s * (T ⟨f, hf⟩ : ZMod N → ℂ))

### PAG224::fullComm（def、87 行）
noncomputable def fullComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Submodule ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) where
  carrier := {T | ∀ (s : ℕ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ),
    T (PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) f) = PAG.Part15.conv (geps N s) (T f) ∧ T (dind N s * f) = dind N s * T f}
  add_mem' := by
    intro T₁ T₂ h₁ h₂
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    intro s f
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, (h₁ s f).1, (h₂ s f).1, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply,
        ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_add]
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, (h₁ s f).2, (h₂ s f).2, mul_add]
  zero_mem' := by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    intro s f
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_zero]
    · rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro r T hT
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hT ⊢
    intro s f
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, (hT s f).1, ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply,
        ← PAG.Part15.convL_apply, map_smul]
    · rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, (hT s f).2, mul_smul_comm]
