### PAG224::commToFamily（def、197 行）
noncomputable def commToFamily (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    fullComm N →ₗ[ℂ] ((p : BlockIdx N × BlockIdx N) → blockHom N p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.2.1) where
  toFun T p := ⟨commBlock N p.1 p.2 T, commBlock_mem N p.1 p.2 T.2⟩
  map_add' T₁ T₂ := by
    funext p
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply Subtype.ext
    show blockProjL N p.2.1 p.2.2.1 (((T₁ + T₂ : fullComm N) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f) =
      blockProjL N p.2.1 p.2.2.1 ((T₁ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f) +
        blockProjL N p.2.1 p.2.2.1 ((T₂ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f)
    rw [Submodule.coe_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]
  map_smul' r T := by
    funext p
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply Subtype.ext
    show blockProjL N p.2.1 p.2.2.1 (((r • T : fullComm N) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f) =
      r • blockProjL N p.2.1 p.2.2.1 ((T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f)
    rw [Submodule.coe_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]

### PAG224::familyToComm（def、221 行）
noncomputable def familyToComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    ((p : BlockIdx N × BlockIdx N) → blockHom N p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.2.1) →ₗ[ℂ] fullComm N where
  toFun X := ⟨commSum N X, commSum_mem N X⟩
  map_add' X₁ X₂ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show commSum N (X₁ + X₂) = commSum N X₁ + commSum N X₂
    unfold commSum
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => ?_)
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro g
    rfl
  map_smul' r X := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show commSum N (r • X) = r • commSum N X
    unfold commSum
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => ?_)
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro g
    rfl

### PAG224::dilCommute（def、402 行）
noncomputable def dilCommute (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Submodule ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) where
  carrier := {T | ∀ (a : (ZMod N)ˣ) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), T (dil a f) = dil a (T f)}
  add_mem' := by
    intro T₁ T₂ h₁ h₂
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    intro a f
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, h₁ a f, h₂ a f, map_add]
  zero_mem' := by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    intro a f
    rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro r T hT
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hT ⊢
    intro a f
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hT a f, map_smul]

### PAG224::dilCommToFamily（def、464 行）
noncomputable def dilCommToFamily (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    dilComm N →ₗ[ℂ] ((b : BlockIdx N) → blockHom N b.1 b.1 b.2.1 b.2.1) where
  toFun T b := ⟨commBlock N b b T, commBlock_mem N b b ((mem_dilComm N T).mp T.2).1⟩
  map_add' T₁ T₂ := by
    funext b
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply Subtype.ext
    show blockProjL N b.1 b.2.1 (((T₁ + T₂ : dilComm N) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f) =
      blockProjL N b.1 b.2.1 ((T₁ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f) +
        blockProjL N b.1 b.2.1 ((T₂ : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f)
    rw [Submodule.coe_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]
  map_smul' r T := by
    funext b
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply Subtype.ext
    show blockProjL N b.1 b.2.1 (((r • T : dilComm N) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f) =
      r • blockProjL N b.1 b.2.1 ((T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) f)
    rw [Submodule.coe_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]

### PAG224::familyToDilComm（def、488 行）
noncomputable def familyToDilComm (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    ((b : BlockIdx N) → blockHom N b.1 b.1 b.2.1 b.2.1) →ₗ[ℂ] dilComm N where
  toFun Y := ⟨diagSum N Y, diagSum_mem N Y⟩
  map_add' Y₁ Y₂ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show diagSum N (Y₁ + Y₂) = diagSum N Y₁ + diagSum N Y₂
    unfold diagSum
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro g
    rfl
  map_smul' r Y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show diagSum N (r • Y) = r • diagSum N Y
    unfold diagSum
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro g
    rfl

### PAG225::layerAlgHom（def、397 行）
noncomputable def layerAlgHom (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero c] (hcN : c ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : (layerIdx c (N / c) → ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] blockCommAlg N c hcN χ hχ :=
  AlgHom.ofLinearMap
    { toFun := fun a => ⟨∑ d, a d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d,
        (mem_blockCommAlg N c hcN χ hχ _).mpr (Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun d _ =>
          Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (layerProjV_mem_blockComm N c hcN χ hχ d)))⟩
      map_add' := fun a b => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show ∑ d, (a + b) d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d =
          ∑ d, a d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d + ∑ d, b d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := fun r a => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show ∑ d, (r • a) d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d = r • ∑ d, a d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, Finset.smul_sum] }
    (by
      apply Subtype.ext
      show ∑ d, (1 : layerIdx c (N / c) → ℂ) d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d = 1
      simp only [Pi.one_apply, one_smul]
      exact sum_layerProjV N c hcN χ)
    (fun a b => by
      apply Subtype.ext
      show ∑ d, (a * b) d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d =
        (∑ d, a d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d) * ∑ d, b d • layerProjV N c hcN χ d
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      simp only [smul_mul_smul_comm, layerProjV_mul, smul_ite, smul_zero]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
      simp)

### PAG226::fullCommCenter（def、169 行）
noncomputable def fullCommCenter (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Submodule ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) where
  carrier := {Z | Z ∈ fullComm N ∧ ∀ T ∈ fullComm N, Commute Z T}
  add_mem' := by
    intro Z₁ Z₂ h₁ h₂
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    exact ⟨Submodule.add_mem _ h₁.1 h₂.1, fun T hT => (h₁.2 T hT).add_left (h₂.2 T hT)⟩
  zero_mem' := by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    exact ⟨Submodule.zero_mem _, fun T _ => Commute.zero_left T⟩
  smul_mem' := by
    intro r Z h
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h ⊢
    exact ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ r h.1, fun T hT => (h.2 T hT).smul_left r⟩

### PAG226::layerScalar（def、205 行）
noncomputable def layerScalar (N c : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c) (d : ℕ)
    (Z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) : ℂ :=
  (N : ℂ) / (Nat.totient (d * c) : ℂ) * ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (gblock N c χ d x) * Z (gblock N c χ d) x

### PAG226::centerIdx（def、259 行）
noncomputable def centerIdx (N : ℕ) : Finset (Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) :=
  (N.divisors.filter (fun c => 0 < Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ c // χ.IsPrimitive})).sigma
    (fun c => layerIdx c (N / c))

### PAG226::mem_centerIdx（theorem、264 行）
theorem mem_centerIdx (N : ℕ) (p : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) : p ∈ centerIdx N ↔
    p.1 ∈ N.divisors ∧ 0 < Nat.card {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p.1 // χ.IsPrimitive} ∧
      p.2 ∈ layerIdx p.1 (N / p.1)

### PAG226::centerAlgHom（def、520 行）
noncomputable def centerAlgHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    (centerIdx N → ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] centerAlg N :=
  AlgHom.ofLinearMap
    { toFun := fun a => ⟨∑ j, a j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2, (mem_centerAlg N _).mpr (sum_smul_centralElt_mem N a)⟩
      map_add' := fun a b => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show ∑ j, (a + b) j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2 =
          ∑ j, a j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2 + ∑ j, b j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := fun r a => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show ∑ j, (r • a) j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2 = r • ∑ j, a j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, Finset.smul_sum] }
    (by
      apply Subtype.ext
      show ∑ j, (1 : centerIdx N → ℂ) j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2 = 1
      simp only [Pi.one_apply, one_smul]
      exact sum_centralElt N)
    (fun a b => by
      apply Subtype.ext
      show ∑ j, (a * b) j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2 =
        (∑ j, a j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2) * ∑ j, b j • centralElt N j.1.1 j.1.2
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      simp only [smul_mul_smul_comm, centralElt_mul, smul_ite, smul_zero]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
      simp)

### PAG226::centerMathlibEquiv（def、571 行）
noncomputable def centerMathlibEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Subalgebra.center ℂ (fullCommAlg N) ≃ₐ[ℂ] centerAlg N where
  toFun Z := ⟨Z.1.1, (mem_centerAlg N _).mpr ((mem_center_fullCommAlg N Z.1).mp Z.2)⟩
  invFun Z := ⟨⟨Z.1, (mem_fullCommAlg N _).mpr ((mem_fullCommCenter N _).mp ((mem_centerAlg N _).mp Z.2)).1⟩,
    (mem_center_fullCommAlg N _).mpr ((mem_centerAlg N _).mp Z.2)⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_mul' _ _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  commutes' _ := rfl

### PAG226::centerEquivPi（def、583 行）
noncomputable def centerEquivPi (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] [Fintype (BlockIdx N)] :
    (centerIdx N → ℂ) ≃ₐ[ℂ] Subalgebra.center ℂ (fullCommAlg N) :=
  (centerAlgEquiv N).trans (centerMathlibEquiv N).symm

### PAG226::centerLinearEquiv（def、588 行）
noncomputable def centerLinearEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    Subalgebra.center ℂ (fullCommAlg N) ≃ₗ[ℂ] fullCommCenter N where
  toFun Z := ⟨Z.1.1, (mem_center_fullCommAlg N Z.1).mp Z.2⟩
  invFun Z := ⟨⟨Z.1, (mem_fullCommAlg N _).mpr ((mem_fullCommCenter N _).mp Z.2).1⟩,
    (mem_center_fullCommAlg N _).mpr Z.2⟩
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

### PAG227::matAlgHom（def、377 行）
noncomputable def matAlgHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] fullCommAlg N :=
  AlgHom.ofLinearMap
    { toFun := fun M => ⟨matSum N M, (mem_fullCommAlg N _).mpr (matSum_mem_fullComm N M)⟩
      map_add' := fun M M' => Subtype.ext (by
        show matSum N (M + M') = matSum N M + matSum N M'
        exact matSum_add N M M')
      map_smul' := fun r M => Subtype.ext (by
        show matSum N (r • M) = r • matSum N M
        exact matSum_smul N r M) }
    (Subtype.ext (by
      show matSum N 1 = 1
      exact matSum_one N))
    (fun M M' => Subtype.ext (by
      show matSum N (M * M') = matSum N M * matSum N M'
      exact matSum_mul N M M'))

    (matAlgHom N M : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) = matSum N M

    (Π p : centerIdx N, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] fullCommAlg N where

### PAG228::doubleCommLinearEquiv（def、269 行）
noncomputable def doubleCommLinearEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    doubleComm N ≃ₗ[ℂ] Π p : centerIdx N, Module.End ℂ (refLayer N p) where

  invFun S := ⟨liftOp N S, liftOp_mem N S⟩
  map_add' T T' := map_add (restrictHom N) T T'
  map_smul' r T := map_smul (restrictHom N) r T
  left_inv T := Subtype.ext (liftOp_restrictHom N T)
  right_inv S := restrictHom_liftOp N S

### PAG229::adjOp（def、171 行）
noncomputable def adjOp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun g y := ∑ x, starRingEnd ℂ (T (Pi.single y 1) x) * g x
  map_add' g g' := by
    funext y
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c g := by
    funext y
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
    ring

### PAG229::perpSub（def、220 行）
noncomputable def perpSub (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))}
    (hB : AdjClosed N B) (K : Submodule B (ZMod N → ℂ)) : Submodule B (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  carrier := {g | ∀ k ∈ K, herm N k g = 0}
  add_mem' := fun {g g'} hg hg' k hk => by rw [herm_add_right, hg k hk, hg' k hk, add_zero]
  zero_mem' := fun k _ => by unfold herm; simp
  smul_mem' := fun a g hg k hk => by
    obtain ⟨a', ha', e⟩ := hB a.1 a.2
    have hk' : (⟨a', ha'⟩ : B) • k ∈ K := K.smul_mem _ hk
    show herm N k ((a : Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ)) g) = 0
    rw [← herm_conj, e, herm_conj]
    exact hg _ hk'

### PAG229::toEuclid（def、241 行）
noncomputable def toEuclid (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ))}
    (K : Submodule B (ZMod N → ℂ)) : Submodule ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (ZMod N)) where
  carrier := {x | WithLp.ofLp x ∈ K}
  add_mem' := fun {x y} hx hy => by
    show WithLp.ofLp (x + y) ∈ K
    rw [WithLp.ofLp_add]; exact K.add_mem hx hy
  zero_mem' := by
    show WithLp.ofLp (0 : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ZMod N)) ∈ K
    rw [WithLp.ofLp_zero]; exact K.zero_mem
  smul_mem' := fun c x hx => by
    show WithLp.ofLp (c • x) ∈ K
    rw [WithLp.ofLp_smul, ← algebraMap_sub_smul N B]
    exact K.smul_mem _ hx

    Subalgebra.center ℂ (shellAlg N) ≃ₐ[ℂ] centerAlg N where
  toFun Z := ⟨Z.1.1, (mem_centerAlg N _).mpr ((mem_center_shellAlg N Z.1).mp Z.2)⟩

  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_mul' _ _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  commutes' _ := rfl

### PAG231::bimodMap（def、38 行）
noncomputable def bimodMap (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : bimodSpace N →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun w := ∑ p : centerIdx N, ∑ χ : Prim p.1.1,
    matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 (refChar N p).1 χ.1 (w p χ : ZMod N → ℂ)
  map_add' w w' := by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add, map_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' r w := by
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, map_smul, Finset.smul_sum, RingHom.id_apply]

    matUnit N q.1.1 q.1.2 j.1 i.1 (bimodMap N w) =
      matUnit N q.1.1 q.1.2 (refChar N q).1 i.1 (w q j : ZMod N → ℂ)

### PAG231::bimodInv（def、74 行）
noncomputable def bimodInv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] bimodSpace N where
  toFun f p χ := ⟨matUnit N p.1.1 p.1.2 χ.1 (refChar N p).1 f, matUnit_mem_refLayer N p χ f⟩
  map_add' f g := by
    funext p χ
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [map_add, Pi.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add]
  map_smul' r f := by
    funext p χ
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [map_smul, Pi.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, RingHom.id_apply]

### PAG231::tensorFunEquiv（def、319 行）
noncomputable def tensorFunEquiv (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] : TensorProduct ℂ W (ι → ℂ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] (ι → W) :=
  (TensorProduct.congr (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ W) (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite ℂ ℂ ι).symm) ≪≫ₗ
    TensorProduct.finsuppScalarRight ℂ ℂ W ι ≪≫ₗ Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite ℂ W ι

    [DecidableEq ι] (w : W) (v : ι → ℂ) (i : ι) :
    tensorFunEquiv W ι (w ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v) i = v i • w

### PAG232::leftOp（def、187 行）
noncomputable def leftOp {a : ℕ} (b : ℕ) (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) where
  toFun F p := S (fun x => F (x, p.2)) p.1
  map_add' F G := by
    funext p
    show S ((fun x => F (x, p.2)) + (fun x => G (x, p.2))) p.1 = _
    rw [map_add]
    rfl
  map_smul' c F := by
    funext p
    show S (c • (fun x => F (x, p.2))) p.1 = _
    rw [map_smul]
    rfl

### PAG232::rightOp（def、201 行）
noncomputable def rightOp (a : ℕ) {b : ℕ} (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) where
  toFun F p := T (fun y => F (p.1, y)) p.2
  map_add' F G := by
    funext p
    show T ((fun y => F (p.1, y)) + (fun y => G (p.1, y))) p.2 = _
    rw [map_add]
    rfl
  map_smul' c F := by
    funext p
    show T (c • (fun y => F (p.1, y))) p.2 = _
    rw [map_smul]
    rfl

### PAG232::leftHom（def、223 行）
noncomputable def leftHom (a b : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) :=
  AlgHom.ofLinearMap
    { toFun := leftOp b
      map_add' := fun _ _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl }
    (LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl)
    (fun _ _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl)

      map_add' := fun _ _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl }
    (LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl)
    (fun _ _ => LinearMap.ext fun _ => funext fun _ => rfl)

### PAG233::tensLiftGen（def、89 行）
noncomputable def tensLiftGen {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (B : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)))
    (B' : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))) :
    TensorProduct ℂ B B' →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) :=
  Algebra.TensorProduct.lift ((leftHom a b).comp B.val) ((rightHom a b).comp B'.val)
    (fun x y => leftOp_commute_rightOp (x : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) (y : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ)))

### PAG234::matE（def、29 行）
noncomputable def matE {b : ℕ} (p : ZMod b × ZMod b) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ) where
  toFun h y'' := if y'' = p.1 then h p.2 else 0
  map_add' h k := by
    funext y''
    by_cases hy : y'' = p.1 <;> simp [hy]
  map_smul' c h := by
    funext y''
    by_cases hy : y'' = p.1 <;> simp [hy]

### PAG234::matE_apply（theorem、39 行）
theorem matE_apply {b : ℕ} (p : ZMod b × ZMod b) (h : ZMod b → ℂ) (y'' : ZMod b) :
    matE p h y'' = if y'' = p.1 then h p.2 else 0

### PAG234::inclY（def、43 行）
noncomputable def inclY {a b : ℕ} (y' : ZMod b) : (ZMod a → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod a × ZMod b → ℂ) where
  toFun f q := if q.2 = y' then f q.1 else 0
  map_add' f g := by
    funext q
    by_cases hq : q.2 = y' <;> simp [hq]
  map_smul' c f := by
    funext q
    by_cases hq : q.2 = y' <;> simp [hq]

### PAG234::inclY_apply（theorem、53 行）
theorem inclY_apply {a b : ℕ} (y' : ZMod b) (f : ZMod a → ℂ) (q : ZMod a × ZMod b) :
    inclY y' f q = if q.2 = y' then f q.1 else 0

### PAG234::restrY（def、57 行）

  toFun F x := F (x, y)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

### PAG235::unitLeft（def、75 行）
noncomputable def unitLeft {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (v : (ZMod a)ˣ) : (ZMod (a * b))ˣ where
  val := (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab).symm ((v : ZMod a), 1)
  inv := (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab).symm (((v⁻¹ : (ZMod a)ˣ) : ZMod a), 1)
  val_inv := by
    rw [← map_mul, Prod.mk_mul_mk, Units.mul_inv, mul_one]
    exact map_one _
  inv_val := by
    rw [← map_mul, Prod.mk_mul_mk, Units.inv_mul, mul_one]
    exact map_one _

noncomputable def dilCommAlgLinearEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : dilCommAlg N ≃ₗ[ℂ] dilComm N where

  map_add' _ _ := rfl

### PAG236::charMul（def、34 行）
noncomputable def charMul {m n : ℕ} (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) :
    DirichletCharacter ℂ (m * n) :=
  DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (dvd_mul_right m n) χ₁ * DirichletCharacter.changeLevel (dvd_mul_left n m) χ₂

### PAG236::changeLevel_charMul（theorem、39 行）
theorem changeLevel_charMul {m n N : ℕ} (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n)
    (h : m * n ∣ N) :
    DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h (charMul χ₁ χ₂) =
      DirichletCharacter.changeLevel ((dvd_mul_right m n).trans h) χ₁ *
        DirichletCharacter.changeLevel ((dvd_mul_left n m).trans h) χ₂

### PAG236::crtConj_blockProjL_exists（theorem、407 行）
theorem crtConj_blockProjL_exists {a b ca cb : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]

theorem crtConj_layerBlockProj {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)] [Fintype (BlockIdx b)]

### PAG237::exists_gauge_crtConj_matUnit（theorem、231 行）
theorem exists_gauge_crtConj_matUnit {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [Fintype (BlockIdx a)]
    [Fintype (BlockIdx b)] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ca da cb db : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (hp : (⟨ca, da⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx a) (hq : (⟨cb, db⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) ∈ centerIdx b)
    {χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ (ca * cb)} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (hχ' : χ'.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ χa χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca, ∃ χb χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb,
      χa.IsPrimitive ∧ χa'.IsPrimitive ∧ χb.IsPrimitive ∧ χb'.IsPrimitive ∧
        charMul χa χb = χ ∧ charMul χa' χb' = χ' ∧
          gaugeFactor da db χa' χb' • crtConj hab (matUnit (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db) χ χ') =
            gaugeFactor da db χa χb • (leftOp b (matUnit a ca da χa χa') * rightOp a (matUnit b cb db χb χb'))

### PAG237::gaugeUnit（def、248 行）
noncomputable def gaugeUnit (a b ca da cb db : ℕ) [NeZero a] [NeZero b] [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb]
    (χa χa' : DirichletCharacter ℂ ca) (χb χb' : DirichletCharacter ℂ cb) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ) :=
  (gaugeFactor da db χa' χb' / gaugeFactor da db χa χb) •
    matUnit (a * b) (ca * cb) (da * db) (charMul χa χb) (charMul χa' χb')

    Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) :=

### PAG238::kronG（def、56 行）
noncomputable def kronG {ca cb : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb] (hcop : Nat.Coprime ca cb) (da db : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (Prim ca) (Prim ca) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Prim cb) (Prim cb) ℂ) :
    Matrix (Prim (ca * cb)) (Prim (ca * cb)) ℂ :=
  fun χ χ' => (gaugeP da db ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ) / gaugeP da db ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ')) *
    (A ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ).1 ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ').1 *
      B ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ).2 ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ').2)

### PAG238::kronG_apply（theorem、64 行）
theorem kronG_apply {ca cb : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb] (hcop : Nat.Coprime ca cb) (da db : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (Prim ca) (Prim ca) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Prim cb) (Prim cb) ℂ) (x y : Prim ca × Prim cb) :
    kronG hcop da db A B (primEquiv hcop x) (primEquiv hcop y) =
      (gaugeP da db x / gaugeP da db y) * (A x.1 y.1 * B x.2 y.2)

### PAG238::kronG_eq（theorem、71 行）
theorem kronG_eq {ca cb : ℕ} [NeZero ca] [NeZero cb] (hcop : Nat.Coprime ca cb) (da db : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (Prim ca) (Prim ca) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Prim cb) (Prim cb) ℂ) :
    kronG hcop da db A B = Matrix.diagonal (fun χ => gaugeP da db ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ)) *
      Matrix.reindex (primEquiv hcop) (primEquiv hcop) (Matrix.kroneckerMap (· * ·) A B) *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun χ => (gaugeP da db ((primEquiv hcop).symm χ))⁻¹)

### PAG238::crtConj_blockSum（theorem、129 行）

### PAG238::centerIdxEquiv（def、175 行）
noncomputable def centerIdxEquiv {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) : centerIdx (a * b) ≃ centerIdx a × centerIdx b where
  toFun r := (⟨(idxSplit a b r.1).1, (idxSplit_mem hab (c := r.1.1) (d := r.1.2) r.2).1⟩,
    ⟨(idxSplit a b r.1).2, (idxSplit_mem hab (c := r.1.1) (d := r.1.2) r.2).2⟩)
  invFun pq := ⟨idxMul pq.1.1 pq.2.1,
    idxMul_mem_centerIdx hab (ca := pq.1.1.1) (da := pq.1.1.2) (cb := pq.2.1.1) (db := pq.2.1.2) pq.1.2 pq.2.2⟩
  left_inv r := Subtype.ext (idxMul_idxSplit hab (c := r.1.1) (d := r.1.2) r.2)
  right_inv pq := by
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨ca, da⟩, hp⟩, ⟨⟨cb, db⟩, hq⟩⟩ := pq
    have h := idxSplit_idxMul hab hp hq
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.fst h)) (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.snd h))

### PAG238::tensorFamily（def、209 行）
noncomputable def tensorFamily {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b)
    (Ma : Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ)
    (Mb : Π q : centerIdx b, Matrix (Prim q.1.1) (Prim q.1.1) ℂ) :
    Π r : centerIdx (a * b), Matrix (Prim r.1.1) (Prim r.1.1) ℂ :=
  fun r => (kronG (coprime_of_mem_centerIdx hab (centerIdxEquiv hab r).1.2 (centerIdxEquiv hab r).2.2)
      (centerIdxEquiv hab r).1.1.2 (centerIdxEquiv hab r).2.1.2
      (Ma (centerIdxEquiv hab r).1) (Mb (centerIdxEquiv hab r).2)).submatrix
    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Prim (centerIdxEquiv_fst_mul hab r)))
    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Prim (centerIdxEquiv_fst_mul hab r)))

    (Π p : centerIdx a, Matrix (Prim p.1.1) (Prim p.1.1) ℂ) ⊗[ℂ]

    ((fullCommTensorEquiv hab).trans (fullCommMatrixEquiv (a * b)).symm)

  | [], _ => Nat.coprime_one_right _
  | b :: l, h => Nat.Coprime.mul_right (h b (by simp)) (coprime_prodList fun c hc => h c (by simp [hc]))

### PAG240::locHom（def、76 行）
noncomputable def locHom : (l : List ℕ+) → CoprimeList l → (k : Fin l.length) →
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ℂ) →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod (prodList l) → ℂ)

### PAG240::locHom_injective（theorem、92 行）
theorem locHom_injective : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length),
    Function.Injective (locHom l h k)
  | a :: l, h, ⟨0, _⟩ => by
    intro S T hST
    exact leftHom_injective (a : ℕ) (prodList l) ((crtConj h.head).symm.injective hST)
  | a :: l, h, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ => by
    intro S T hST
    exact locHom_injective l h.tail ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk⟩

### PAG240::locHom_commute（theorem、103 行）
theorem locHom_commute : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) {j k : Fin l.length} (_ : j ≠ k)
    (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((l.get j : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ℂ)) (T : Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ℂ)),
    Commute (locHom l h j S) (locHom l h k T)
  | _ :: _, _, ⟨0, _⟩, ⟨0, _⟩, hjk, _, _ => (hjk rfl).elim
  | a :: l, h, ⟨0, _⟩, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩, _, S, T => by
    exact (leftOp_commute_rightOp S (locHom l h.tail ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk⟩ T)).map (crtConj h.head).symm
  | a :: l, h, ⟨j + 1, hj⟩, ⟨0, _⟩, _, S, T => by
    exact ((leftOp_commute_rightOp T (locHom l h.tail ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩ S)).map
      (crtConj h.head).symm).symm
  | a :: l, h, ⟨j + 1, hj⟩, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩, hjk, S, T => by
    have hne : (⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩ : Fin l.length) ≠ ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk⟩

### PAG240::locHom_apply（theorem、183 行）
theorem locHom_apply : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length)
    (S : Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ℂ)) (F : ZMod (prodList l) → ℂ) (x : ZMod (prodList l)),
    locHom l h k S F x = S (fun y => F (liftL l h k x y)) (ZMod.castHom (get_dvd_prodList l k) _ x)
  | a :: l, h, ⟨0, _⟩, S, F, x => by
    show S (fun u => F ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head).symm (u, (ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head x).2)))
        (ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head x).1 =
      S (fun y => F ((ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head).symm (y, (ZMod.chineseRemainder h.head x).2)))
        (ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right (a : ℕ) (prodList l)) (ZMod (a : ℕ)) x)
    rw [crt_fst_eq_castHom h.head]
  | a :: l, h, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩, S, F, x => by

### PAG240::CRTMul（def、276 行）
def CRTMul (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ))) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : ℕ) [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b),
    (X (a * b)).map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom = (X a).map (leftHom a b) ⊔ (X b).map (rightHom a b)

    (Y : Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod (a * b) → ℂ))) :
    (Y.map (crtConj hab).toAlgHom).map (crtConj hab).symm.toAlgHom = Y

### PAG240::finrank_prodList（theorem、351 行）
theorem finrank_prodList (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ)))
    (hX : CRTMul X) : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (_ : CoprimeList l),
    Module.finrank ℂ (X (prodList l)) = (l.map (fun a : ℕ+ => Module.finrank ℂ (X (a : ℕ)))).prod

      finrank_sup_map]

### PAG240::tensEquiv（def、381 行）
noncomputable def tensEquiv (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ)))
    (hX : CRTMul X) : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (_ : CoprimeList l), (tensAlg X l).carrier ≃ₐ[ℂ] X (prodList l)
  | [], _ => (Algebra.botEquiv ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod 1 → ℂ))).symm.trans
      (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ (eq_bot_of_one (X 1)).symm)
  | a :: l, h => (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr AlgEquiv.refl (tensEquiv X hX l h.tail)).trans

        (hX (a : ℕ) (prodList l) h.head))

theorem tensEquiv_tmul (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ)))

### PAG240::tprodL（def、415 行）

### PAG240::tensEquiv_tprodL（theorem、422 行）
theorem tensEquiv_tprodL (X : ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (ZMod n → ℂ)))
    (hX : CRTMul X) : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (h : CoprimeList l) (S : ∀ k : Fin l.length, X ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ)),
    (tensEquiv X hX l h (tprodL X l S) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (prodList l) → ℂ)) =
      (List.ofFn (fun k => locHom l h k (S k : Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) → ℂ)))).prod
  | [], h, S => by
    rw [List.ofFn_zero, List.prod_nil, show tprodL X [] S = 1 from rfl, map_one]
    rfl
  | a :: l, h, S => by
    rw [List.ofFn_succ, List.prod_cons]
    show (tensEquiv X hX (a :: l) h (S ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩ ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
      tprodL X l (fun k => S ⟨k.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ k.isLt⟩) :
        TensorProduct ℂ (X (a : ℕ)) (tensAlg X l).carrier) : Module.End ℂ (ZMod (prodList (a :: l)) → ℂ)) = _
    rw [tensEquiv_tmul, tensEquiv_tprodL X hX l h.tail (fun k => S ⟨k.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ k.isLt⟩)]
    have hφ

### PAG241::CommFam（def、41 行）
def CommFam (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ (x : A i) (y : A j), Commute (φ i x) (φ j y)

### PAG241::tpProd（def、47 行）
noncomputable def tpProd (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) (x : ∀ i, A i) : B :=
  Finset.univ.noncommProd (fun i => φ i (x i)) (pwComm (fun i j hij => hφ i j hij (x i) (x j)) _)

### PAG241::tpProd_eq_mul_erase（theorem、51 行）
theorem tpProd_eq_mul_erase [DecidableEq ι] (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ)
    (x : ∀ i, A i) (i : ι) :
    tpProd φ hφ x = φ i (x i) * (Finset.univ.erase i).noncommProd (fun j => φ j (x j))
      (pwComm (fun j k hjk => hφ j k hjk (x j) (x k)) _)

### PAG241::tpProd_update（theorem、58 行）

    (i : ι) (v : A i) :
    tpProd φ hφ (Function.update m i v) = φ i v * (Finset.univ.erase i).noncommProd
      (fun j => φ j (m j)) (pwComm (fun j k hjk => hφ j k hjk (m j) (m k)) _)

    (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[ℂ] B) (hφ : CommFam φ) (T : Subalgebra ℂ B) (hT : T = ⨆ i, (φ i).range)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℂ T = ∏ i, Module.finrank ℂ (A i)) (i : ι) (a : A i) :
    (tpEquiv φ hφ T hT hdim (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom i a) : B) = φ i a

### PAG241::endCongr（def、206 行）
noncomputable def endCongr {M N : ℕ} (h : M = N) :
    Module.End ℂ (ZMod M → ℂ) ≃ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) := by
  subst h; exact AlgEquiv.refl

### PAG241::crtE（def、214 行）

    ZMod N ≃+* ZMod a × ZMod (N / a) :=
  (ZMod.ringEquivCongr (Nat.mul_div_cancel' hd).symm).trans (ZMod.chineseRemainder hc)

### PAG241::coprime_get_div（theorem、280 行）
theorem coprime_get_div : ∀ (l : List ℕ+) (_ : CoprimeList l) (k : Fin l.length),
    Nat.Coprime ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ) (prodList l / ((l.get k : ℕ+) : ℕ))
  | a :: l, h, ⟨0, _⟩ => by
    show Nat.Coprime (a : ℕ) ((a : ℕ) * prodList l / (a : ℕ))
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ a.pos]
    exact h.head
  | b :: l, h, ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ => by
    have hk' : k < l.length

theorem commute_locOp_pp (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {p q : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ N.primeFactors)

### PAG242::piSplitAlgEquiv（def、31 行）
def piSplitAlgEquiv {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (i₀ : ι) (B : ι → Type*) [∀ i, Semiring (B i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra ℂ (B i)] : (Π i, B i) ≃ₐ[ℂ] B i₀ × Π i : {i // i ≠ i₀}, B i :=
  { Equiv.piSplitAt i₀ B with
    map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl
    map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
    commutes' := fun _ => rfl }

### PAG242::piSplitAlgEquiv_apply（theorem、39 行）
theorem piSplitAlgEquiv_apply {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (i₀ : ι) (B : ι → Type*) [∀ i, Semiring (B i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra ℂ (B i)] (f : Π i, B i) :
    piSplitAlgEquiv i₀ B f = (f i₀, fun j : {i // i ≠ i₀} => f j)

### PAG242::matUniqueEquiv（def、44 行）
noncomputable def matUniqueEquiv (m : Type*) [Unique m] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] :
    Matrix m m ℂ ≃ₐ[ℂ] ℂ :=
  AlgEquiv.ofLinearEquiv
    { toFun := fun M => M default default
      invFun := fun r => Matrix.of fun _ _ => r
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl
      left_inv := fun M => by
        ext i j
        rw [Subsingleton.elim i default, Subsingleton.elim j default]
        rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
    (Matrix.one_apply_eq default)
    (fun M M' => by
      show (M * M') default default = M default default * M' default default
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_unique])

### PAG242::matUniqueEquiv_apply（theorem、62 行）
theorem matUniqueEquiv_apply (m : Type*) [Unique m] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (M : Matrix m m ℂ) :
    matUniqueEquiv m M = M default default

### PAG242::tpCongr（def、84 行）
noncomputable def tpCongr (e : ∀ i, A i ≃ₐ[ℂ] B i) : (⨂[ℂ] i, A i) ≃ₐ[ℂ] ⨂[ℂ] i, B i :=
  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom
    (tpLift (fun i => (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom i).comp (e i).toAlgHom) (commFam_single_equiv e))
    (tpLift (fun i => (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom i).comp (e i).symm.toAlgHom)
      (commFam_single_equiv fun i => (e i).symm))
    (PiTensorProduct.algHom_ext fun i => AlgHom.ext fun b => by
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, tpLift_single]
      exact congrArg _ ((e i).apply_symm_apply b))
    (PiTensorProduct.algHom_ext fun i => AlgHom.ext fun a => by
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, tpLift_single]
      exact congrArg _ ((e i).symm_apply_apply a))

### PAG242::shellAlgPrimePowEquiv（def、313 行）
noncomputable def shellAlgPrimePowEquiv {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (k : ℕ) [NeZero (q ^ k)] :
    shellAlg (q ^ k) ≃ₐ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) ℂ × (restIdx (q ^ k) → ℂ) :=

    (piSplitAlgEquiv (baseIdx (q ^ k)) _).trans <|
      AlgEquiv.prodCongr
        (Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv ℂ ℂ (finCongr (finrank_refLayer_base_primePow hq k)))
        (AlgEquiv.piCongrRight fun p =>
          (Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv ℂ ℂ (finCongr (finrank_refLayer_rest hq k p))).trans
            (matUniqueEquiv (Fin 1)))

### PAG242::endTensorEquiv_tprod（theorem、380 行）
theorem endTensorEquiv_tprod (N : ℕ) [NeZero N]
    (S : ∀ p : N.primeFactors, Module.End ℂ (ZMod ((p : ℕ) ^ N.factorization p) → ℂ)) :
    endTensorEquiv N (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ S) =

        (Nat.ordProj_dvd N p) (coprime_ordProj N p.2) (S p))
        (pwComm (fun p q hpq => commute_locOp_pp N p.2 q.2 (fun e => hpq (Subtype.ext e)) _ _) _)

### PAG243::radialCoord（def、60 行）
noncomputable def radialCoord (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : refLayer N (baseIdx N) ≃ₗ[ℂ] (N.divisors → ℂ) where
  toFun f t := (f : ZMod N → ℂ) ((t : ℕ) : ZMod N)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  invFun c := ⟨∑ t : N.divisors, c t • dind N t,
    Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun t _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (dind_mem_base N t))⟩
  left_inv f := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show ∑ t : N.divisors, (f : ZMod N → ℂ) ((t : ℕ) : ZMod N) • dind N t = f
    rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort N.divisors (fun t => (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (t : ZMod N) • dind N t)]
    exact (radial_eq_sum ((mem_refLayer_base_iff N _).mp f.2)).symm
  right_inv c := by
    funext u
    show (∑ t : N.divisors, c t • dind N t) ((u : ℕ) : ZMod N) = c u
    rw [Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single u]
    · rw [Pi.smul_apply, dind_natCast _ (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u.2), ite_eq_left rfl, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    · intro t _ htu
      rw [Pi.smul_apply, dind_natCast _ (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors u.2),
        ite_eq_right (fun h => htu (Subtype.ext h.symm)), smul_zero]
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ u) h

noncomputable def radialMatHom (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ →ₙₐ[ℂ] shellAlg N where
  toFun M := ⟨radialMatOp N M, radialMatOp_mem N M⟩
  map_smul' c M := Subtype.ext (show radialMatOp N (c • M) = c • radialMatOp N M by
    simp only [radialMatOp, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, Finset.smul_sum])
  map_zero' := Subtype.ext (show radialMatOp N 0 = 0 by
    simp only [radialMatOp, Matrix.zero_apply, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero])
  map_add' M M' := Subtype.ext (show radialMatOp N (M + M') = radialMatOp N M + radialMatOp N M' by
    simp only [radialMatOp, Matrix.add_apply, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib])
  map_mul' M M' := Subtype.ext (radialMatOp_mul N M M')

### PAG243::radialMatHom_injective（theorem、327 行）
theorem radialMatHom_injective (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Function.Injective (radialMatHom N)

      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * ((N / (t * e) : ℕ) : ℂ) * (if N / (t * e) ∣ u then 1 else 0)

      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * ((N / (t * e) : ℕ) : ℂ) * (if N / (t * e) ∣ (u : ℕ) then 1 else 0)

### PAG243::sum_divisors_primePow_moebius（theorem、494 行）

    ∑ e ∈ (q ^ n).divisors, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℂ) * g e = g 1 - g q

### PAG243::ramMat_primePow（theorem、509 行）
theorem ramMat_primePow {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) {k i j : ℕ} [NeZero (q ^ k)] (hj : j ≤ k) :
    ((q ^ k : ℕ) : ℂ) * geps (q ^ k) (q ^ j) ((q ^ i : ℕ) : ZMod (q ^ k)) =
      if j = k then 1 else
        (if k - j ≤ i then ((q ^ (k - j) : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0) -
          (if k - j - 1 ≤ i then ((q ^ (k - j - 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0)

### PAG243::ramMat_mul_coprime（theorem、530 行）
theorem ramMat_mul_coprime {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) {ua ta ub tb : ℕ}
    (hua : ua ∣ a) (hta : ta ∣ a) (hub : ub ∣ b) (htb : tb ∣ b) :
    ((a * b : ℕ) : ℂ) * geps (a * b) (ta * tb) ((ua * ub : ℕ) : ZMod (a * b)) =
      ((a : ℂ) * geps a ta (ua : ZMod a)) * ((b : ℂ) * geps b tb (ub : ZMod b))

### PAG245::shellDev（def、246 行）

### PAG245::wholeMap（def、476 行）
noncomputable def wholeMap (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × (devSet N → ℂ)) →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun p := radialMatOp N p.1 + ∑ s : devSet N, p.2 s • shellDev N s
  map_add' p q := by
    simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Pi.add_apply, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, radialMatOp_add]
    abel
  map_smul' c p := by
    simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, ← Finset.smul_sum,
      radialMatOp_smul, RingHom.id_apply, smul_add]

theorem wholeMap_apply (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (p : Matrix N.divisors N.divisors ℂ × (devSet N → ℂ)) :
    wholeMap N p = radialMatOp N p.1 + ∑ s : devSet N, p.2 s • shellDev N s

### PAG246::prod_eq_iff（theorem、385 行）
theorem prod_eq_iff (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    (∏ q ∈ N.primeFactors, ((N.factorization q + 1) ^ 2 + N.factorization q * (N.factorization q + 1) / 2 -
        (if q = 2 then N.factorization q else 0))) =
      N.divisors.card ^ 2 + N.divisors.card - 1 - (if 2 ∣ N then 1 else 0) ↔ N = 1 ∨ N = 4 ∨ N.Prime

      LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind q q) * (1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps q 1)) =
      (((q : ℂ) - 1) / (q : ℂ) ^ 2) • PAG.Part15.convL (geps q q)

      LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (dind 2 2) * (1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps 2 2))) = 1 - PAG.Part15.convL (geps 2 2)

### PAG251::sandwich（theorem、212 行）
theorem sandwich {a b : ℕ} [NeZero a] [NeZero b] (c P : Module.End ℂ (ZMod a → ℂ)) (z : Module.End ℂ (ZMod b → ℂ))
    (hz : z * z = z) :
    (1 - PAG.Part232.leftOp b c * PAG.Part232.rightOp a z) * PAG.Part232.leftOp b P *
      (PAG.Part232.leftOp b c * PAG.Part232.rightOp a z) * PAG.Part232.leftOp b P *
      (1 - PAG.Part232.leftOp b c * PAG.Part232.rightOp a z) =
      PAG.Part232.leftOp b ((1 - c) * P * c * P * (1 - c)) * PAG.Part232.rightOp a z

### PAG253::commSubmonoid（def、134 行）
def commSubmonoid {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] (U : (G → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (G → ℂ)) : Submonoid G where
  carrier := {g | U ∘ₗ PAG.transl g = PAG.transl g ∘ₗ U}
  one_mem' := by
    show U ∘ₗ PAG.transl 1 = PAG.transl 1 ∘ₗ U
    rw [transl_one, LinearMap.comp_id, LinearMap.id_comp]
  mul_mem' := by
    intro g h hg hh
    have hg' : U ∘ₗ PAG.transl g = PAG.transl g ∘ₗ U := hg
    have hh' : U ∘ₗ PAG.transl h = PAG.transl h ∘ₗ U := hh
    show U ∘ₗ PAG.transl (g * h) = PAG.transl (g * h) ∘ₗ U
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro f
    have e1 := LinearMap.congr_fun hg' (PAG.transl h f)
    have e2 := LinearMap.congr_fun hh' f
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e1 e2
    simp only [transl_mul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [e1, e2]

### PAG253::primeShift（def、454 行）

### PAG253::thm26_full_of_commute（theorem、581 行）
theorem thm26_full_of_commute {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] [Fintype G] (U : (G → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (G → ℂ))
    (hU : ∀ h, U ∘ₗ PAG.transl h = PAG.transl h ∘ₗ U)
    (hiso : ∀ f g, ipG (U f) (U g) = ipG f g)
    (hadj : ∀ f g, ipG (PAG.rev (U (PAG.rev f))) g = ipG f (U g)) :
    ∃ c : (G →* ℂˣ) → ℂ, (∀ χ, U (PAG.charFun χ) = c χ • PAG.charFun χ) ∧ (∀ χ, ‖c χ‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ χ, c χ⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (c χ)) ∧ (∀ χ, χ⁻¹ = χ → c χ = 1 ∨ c χ = -1)

### PAG253::thm26_full（theorem、595 行）
theorem thm26_full {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (U : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ))
    (hU : ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (hpN : p.Coprime N),
      U ∘ₗ PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) = PAG.transl (kUnit p hpN) ∘ₗ U)
    (hiso : ∀ f g, ipG (U f) (U g) = ipG f g)
    (hadj : ∀ f g, ipG (PAG.rev (U (PAG.rev f))) g = ipG f (U g)) :
    ∃ c : ((ZMod N)ˣ →* ℂˣ) → ℂ, (∀ χ, U (PAG.charFun χ) = c χ • PAG.charFun χ) ∧ (∀ χ, ‖c χ‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ χ, c χ⁻¹ = starRingEnd ℂ (c χ)) ∧ (∀ χ, χ⁻¹ = χ → c χ = 1 ∨ c χ = -1)

### PAG253::signMul（def、710 行）
noncomputable def signMul {G : Type*} [Group G] [DecidableEq G] : (G → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (G → ℂ) where
  toFun f g := (if g = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else -1) * f g
  map_add' f g := by
    funext x
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    ring
  map_smul' c f := by
    funext x
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
    ring

### PAG253::signMul_apply（theorem、722 行）
theorem signMul_apply {G : Type*} [Group G] [DecidableEq G] (f : G → ℂ) (g : G) :
    signMul f g = (if g = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else -1) * f g

    ipG (signMul f) (signMul g) = ipG f g

    (∀ f g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ, ipG (PAG.rev (signMul (PAG.rev f))) g = ipG f (signMul g)) ∧

### PAG254::chainIn（def、95 行）
def chainIn {α : Type*} (S : Set α) (d : α → α → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (x y : α) : Prop :=
  ∃ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → α), c 0 = x ∧ c n = y ∧ (∀ i, i ≤ n → c i ∈ S) ∧ ∀ i, i < n → d (c i) (c (i + 1)) < ε

### PAG255::unitSys（def、147 行）
def unitSys : Subgroup (∀ N : ℕ+, (ZMod (N : ℕ))ˣ) where
  carrier := {a | ∀ (N M : ℕ+) (h : (N : ℕ) ∣ (M : ℕ)), ZMod.unitsMap h (a M) = a N}
  mul_mem' := by
    intro a b ha hb N M h
    rw [Pi.mul_apply, map_mul, ha N M h, hb N M h, Pi.mul_apply]
  one_mem' := by
    intro N M h
    rw [Pi.one_apply, map_one, Pi.one_apply]
  inv_mem' := by
    intro a ha N M h
    rw [Pi.inv_apply, map_inv, ha N M h, Pi.inv_apply]

    casKer t = ((1 - I) * stdAddChar t + (1 + I) * stdAddChar (-t)) / 2

### PAG257::extL（def、61 行）
open Classical in
noncomputable def extL : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ZMod N → ℂ) where
  toFun g x := if h : IsUnit x then g h.unit else 0
  map_add' f g := by
    funext x
    by_cases h : IsUnit x <;> simp [h]
  map_smul' c f := by
    funext x
    by_cases h : IsUnit x <;> simp [h]

### PAG257::extL_apply（theorem、71 行）
open Classical in
theorem extL_apply (g : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) (x : ZMod N) :
    extL g x = if h : IsUnit x then g h.unit else 0

### PAG257::JHL（def、75 行）
noncomputable def JHL : (ZMod N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) where
  toFun f := JH f
  map_add' f g := by
    funext u
    show JH (f + g) u = JH f u + JH g u
    unfold JH hartley
    rw [← add_div, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => by rw [Pi.add_apply, add_mul])
  map_smul' c f := by
    funext u
    show JH (c • f) u = c * JH f u
    unfold JH hartley
    rw [mul_div_assoc', Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => by rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc])

### PAG257::ip_sum_sum（theorem、128 行）
theorem ip_sum_sum {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (a : ι → ℂ) (v : ι → (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ)
    (b : κ → ℂ) (w : κ → (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) :
    ip (N := N) (∑ i, a i • v i) (∑ j, b j • w j) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (starRingEnd ℂ) (a i) * b j * ip (v i) (w j)

### PAG258::UA1（def、156 行）
noncomputable def UA1 : ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ((ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) where
  toFun f := ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N,
    (phaseA1 χ * ip (charU χ) f / (Nat.totient N : ℂ)) • charU χ
  map_add' f g := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => ?_)
    rw [ip_add_right, mul_add, add_div, add_smul]
  map_smul' c f := by
    rw [RingHom.id_apply, Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => ?_)
    rw [ip_smul_right, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    ring

  val : ℕ

### PAG258::（instance、505 行）
instance : DirectedSystem Gsp (fun a b h => (pullSys a b h : Gsp a → Gsp b)) where
  map_self a f := by
    funext u
    show f (ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_refl a.val) u) = f u
    rw [ZMod.unitsMap_self]
    rfl
  map_map c b a hab hbc f := by
    funext u
    show f (ZMod.unitsMap hab (ZMod.unitsMap hbc u)) = f (ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_trans hab hbc) u)
    rw [← ZMod.unitsMap_comp hab hbc]
    rfl

### PAG259::sep_of_mem_zmultiples（theorem、836 行）

    (hy : ∃ n : ℤ, y = n * c) (hne : x ≠ y) : c ≤ |x - y|

### PAG259::mem_zmultiples_of_commensurable（theorem、849 行）
theorem mem_zmultiples_of_commensurable {L₁ L₂ : ℝ} {m : ℤ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (h : (n : ℝ) * L₂ = m * L₁) (a b : ℤ) :
    (a : ℝ) * L₁ + b * L₂ = ((a * n + b * m : ℤ) : ℝ) * (L₁ / n)

### PAG259::sep_of_commensurable（theorem、861 行）
theorem sep_of_commensurable {L₁ L₂ : ℝ} (hL₁ : 0 < L₁) {m : ℤ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (h : (n : ℝ) * L₂ = m * L₁) (a b a' b' : ℤ)
    (hne : (a : ℝ) * L₁ + b * L₂ ≠ a' * L₁ + b' * L₂) :
    L₁ / n ≤ |((a : ℝ) * L₁ + b * L₂) - (a' * L₁ + b' * L₂)|

### PAG259::zpow_ge_of_one_lt（theorem、872 行）

    (p : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ k

### PAG259::exists_between_one（theorem、883 行）
theorem exists_between_one {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) (hne : p ≠ r) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : 1 < y) :
    ∃ a b : ℤ, 1 < (p : ℝ) ^ a * (r : ℝ) ^ b ∧ (p : ℝ) ^ a * (r : ℝ) ^ b < y

### PAG260::（instance、58 行）
instance : NeZero (M * N) := ⟨mul_ne_zero (NeZero.ne M) (NeZero.ne N)⟩

### PAG260::prodChar（def、61 行）
noncomputable def prodChar (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    DirichletCharacter ℂ (M * N) :=
  changeLevel (dvd_mul_right M N) χ₁ * changeLevel (dvd_mul_left N M) χ₂

### PAG260::crtMap（def、66 行）
def crtMap (M N : ℕ) [NeZero M] [NeZero N] (x : ZMod M × ZMod N) : ZMod (M * N) :=
  ((x.1.val * N + x.2.val * M : ℕ) : ZMod (M * N))

### PAG260::cast_crtMap_fst（theorem、70 行）
theorem cast_crtMap_fst (x : ZMod M × ZMod N) :
    ((crtMap M N x : ZMod (M * N)).cast : ZMod M) = x.1 * (N : ZMod M)

### PAG260::cast_crtMap_snd（theorem、78 行）
theorem cast_crtMap_snd (x : ZMod M × ZMod N) :
    ((crtMap M N x : ZMod (M * N)).cast : ZMod N) = x.2 * (M : ZMod N)

### PAG260::crtMap_bijective（theorem、86 行）
theorem crtMap_bijective (h : M.Coprime N) : Function.Bijective (crtMap M N)

### PAG260::stdAddChar_crtMap（theorem、99 行）
theorem stdAddChar_crtMap (x : ZMod M × ZMod N) :
    stdAddChar (crtMap M N x) = stdAddChar x.1 * stdAddChar x.2

### PAG260::prodChar_apply（theorem、116 行）
theorem prodChar_apply (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N)
    (a : ZMod (M * N)) :
    prodChar χ₁ χ₂ a = χ₁ (a.cast : ZMod M) * χ₂ (a.cast : ZMod N)

### PAG260::gaussSum_prodChar（theorem、145 行）
theorem gaussSum_prodChar (h : M.Coprime N) (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    gaussSum (prodChar χ₁ χ₂) stdAddChar =
      χ₁ (N : ZMod M) * χ₂ (M : ZMod N) * gaussSum χ₁ stdAddChar * gaussSum χ₂ stdAddChar

### PAG260::prodChar_neg_one（theorem、161 行）

### PAG260::crossSign（def、168 行）
open Classical in
noncomputable def crossSign (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : ℂ :=
  if χ₁.Odd ∧ χ₂.Odd then -1 else 1

### PAG260::rootNum_prodChar_ne_mul（theorem、308 行）
theorem rootNum_prodChar_ne_mul :
    ∃ (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 3) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 5), χ₁.IsPrimitive ∧ χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧
      χ₁.Odd ∧ χ₂.Odd ∧
      PAG.Part256.rootNum (prodChar χ₁ χ₂) ≠ PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₁ * PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₂

### PAG260::rootNum_prodChar_eq_neg_mul（theorem、339 行）
theorem rootNum_prodChar_eq_neg_mul :
    ∃ (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 3) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 13), χ₁.IsPrimitive ∧
      χ₂.IsPrimitive ∧ χ₁.Odd ∧ χ₂.Odd ∧ χ₁ ((13 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) * χ₂ ((3 : ℕ) : ZMod 13) = 1 ∧
      PAG.Part256.rootNum (prodChar χ₁ χ₂) =
        -(PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₁ * PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₂) ∧
      PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₁ * PAG.Part256.rootNum χ₂ ≠ 0

### PAG260::charU_prodChar（theorem、404 行）
theorem charU_prodChar (χ₁ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (χ₂ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N)
    (u : (ZMod (M * N))ˣ) :
    PAG.Part257.charU (prodChar χ₁ χ₂) u =
      PAG.Part257.charU χ₁ (ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_mul_right M N) u) *
        PAG.Part257.charU χ₂ (ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_mul_left N M) u)
